| | | Peter,

name: Lawrence Reed
subject: 11 Truth Bombs from Milton Friedman
body:
Can you imagine high school students learning about Milton Friedman? Good news — it's happening!
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zlo8e4tpq5r9d5vr8eb05pmqnurf3cm0nn3u1930_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37d1m65qbfctjmkrncst66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2ugpb5d3me1ib6pr3m9im0pbgeepm3d766goe4s9me9j6at9kcuqe2dtietj7fdpnq9o74oj6e2p6cs74mdhmfcjhcoob1ddhcup32pjim2p6co70mlhm1o5l64oracdle8gq48bi4bh28or3chi66oj1cjie49fg)
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgb7mhmnk3nnrob3il2pnlgoku4ve80ka9db5o9o_rp22sh2s8i66or4chhm4ob4sjh2bs)

Friend,

Can you imagine high school students learning about Milton Friedman?

Good news -- it's happening!

**We 're shipping thousands of economic books to high schools across the country with the goal of teaching 23,000 students.**

[_**Friend, can you donate $25, $50, $100, or any amount to help students learn about liberty and economic freedom? Click here to send your gift today >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zh2g7skmen3aj3onisudr23hbg6h6h3vhe00d9f0_rp22sh2s8i66or4chhm4ob4sjh2bs)

These high school students will learn truths like:

> 1.)_ "Underlying most arguments against the free market is a lack of belief in freedom itself." _- Capitalism and Freedom (2002)
>
> 2.)_ "With some notable exceptions, businessmen favor free enterprise in general but are opposed to it when it comes to themselves."_ - Lecture "The Suicidal Impulse of the Business Community" (1983)
>
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zcv82vd6254p0hr1gn9g3bq1dgf5do5v0uida550_rp22sh2s8i66or4chhm4ob4sjh2bs)

> 3.) - America's Drug Forum interview (1991)_" It's a moral problem that the government is making into criminals people, who may be doing something you and I don't approve of, but who are doing something that hurts nobody else." _
>
> 4.)_ "One of the great mistakes is to judge policies and programs by their intentions rather than their results."_ - Interview with Richard Heffner on The Open Mind (1975)
>
> 5.) "You must distinguish sharply between being pro-free enterprise and being pro-business." - Big Business, Big Government (1978)
>
> [_**Friend, can you help us teach high school students these important truths? Click here to donate today >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z56v82lb5c850uac6l6ttp05m2p2b69k1ce5u6u0_rp22sh2s8i66or4chhm4ob4sjh2bs)
>
> 6.) _" The society that puts equality before freedom will end up with neither. The society that puts freedom before equality will end up with a great measure of both."_ - From "Created Equal," an episode of the PBS Free to Choose television series (1980)
>
> 7.)_ "Governments never learn; only people learn."_ - As quoted in The Cynic's Lexicon: A Dictionary Of Amoral Advice (1984)
>
> 8.)_ "We have to recognize that we must not hope for a Utopia that is unattainable. I would like to see a great deal less government activity than we have now, but I do not believe that we can have a situation in which we don't need government at all." _- As quoted in The Times Herald, Norristown, Pennsylvania (Dec. 1, 1978)
>
> 9.)_ "The great virtue of a free market system is that it does not care what color people are; it does not care what their religion is; it only cares whether they can produce something you want to buy. It is the most effective system we have discovered to enable people who hate one another to deal with one another and help one another."_ - "Why Government Is the Problem" (February 1, 1993), p. 19

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zafpa2s4g51fgul71ed0c0up0f09mcndtfqafmv8_rp22sh2s8i66or4chhm4ob4sjh2bs)
> 10.)_ "The case for prohibiting drugs is exactly as strong and as weak as the case for prohibiting people from overeating. We all know that overeating causes more deaths than drugs do." _- America's Drug Forum interview (1991)
>
> 11.) _" There are four ways in which you can spend money. You can spend your own money on yourself. When you do that, why then you really watch out what you're doing, and you try to get the most for your money. Then you can spend your own money on somebody else. For example, I buy a birthday present for someone. Well, then I'm not so careful about the content of the present, but I'm very careful about the cost. Then, I can spend somebody else's money on myself. And if I spend somebody else's money on myself, then I'm sure going to have a good lunch! Finally, I can spend somebody else's money on somebody else. And if I spend somebody else's money on somebody else, I'm not concerned about how much it is, and I'm not concerned about what I get. And that's government. And that's close to 40 percent of our national income." _- Fox News interview (May 2004).

body:
You can still save the day but time is of the essence. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0679%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=pwhBWFT4FdwNvLO9F5EkGw&sysid=1)
You can still save the day but time is of the essence.
Friend, I’m devastated.
Just a few short months ago, Republicans were up by double digits and outraising the Democrats in key battleground races across the country.
_Nancy Pelosi looked like she was on the verge of losing her gavel forever. Far-Left progressives and socialists? Bound for the history books. Then everything changed..._
**The Democrats went into full-on panic mode. **They mobilized an army of Liberal megadonors, they bullied tech companies into running their fundraising ads, they rushed field teams into swing states, they launched smear campaigns against our Pro-Trump friends, they blanketed social media with attack ads, and they rallied the Liberal Media to run cover for them.
[**NOW -- FOR THE FIRST TIME THIS YEAR -- THE DEMOCRATS HAVE TAKEN THE LEAD IN THE NATIONAL POLLS, AND THE BATTLE FOR CONGRESS IS OFFICIALLY A COIN TOSS.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c31948%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=XqghkxNReGOfUyv%2fAMDNxg&sysid=1)
We're on the verge of LOSING the House and Senate.
The number one reason the Democrats are ahead is they're crushing us in fundraising and the resources we have to fight back are severely depleted. **Frankly, we're running on fumes!**
It's officially an emergency situation, so I'll cut to the chase:
[**I'm asking you to to make a small -- but critically important -- donation to help fund our final campaign operations to win back control of Congress.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c31949%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=73b3lQn2hEMAFfaT3phycQ&sysid=1)
I told my team we need to raise $100,000 by tomorrow morning or it'll be too late to save us, and the Democrats will win. _We badly need your help with this. It isn't just another fundraising deadline -- IT'S FOR ALL THE MARBLES!_[****](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c31940%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=0mgcEuvNLo46dRRMjQpGxQ&sysid=1)
**[Pitch In Five Bucks →](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c31941%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=vN7R3PxRjHD6bBKfcXdbbQ&sysid=1)**
**[Pitch In Ten Bucks →](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c31942%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ZDxQZ5lOa6PjX9gtTFI2CQ&sysid=1)**
**[Pitch In Fifty Bucks →](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c31943%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=pyED31NOuxPn2m6qVAFN8w&sysid=1)**
Our hopes of saving this country hinge entirely on loyal grassroots supporters like you.
**The Democrats have a network of big donors, the tech companies are wrapped around their finger, and the Liberal Media does their bidding. There's no changing that. **
_But you can do something about it. You can still save the day but time is of the essence._
[**I know I'm asking a lot from you but this is too important to ignore. We have no choice: we must hit this deadline. Otherwise, we might as well just give up.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c31944%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YHC6q59Tjd%2b3NLjCFYs2aw&sysid=1)
Can we count on you?
For America,
Steve Scalise

| | | Dear Friend, The following message is from James Ackerman, president and chief executive officer of Prison Fellowship. This amazing ministry has made an incredible impact in prisons across the country, restoring lives to Christ and serving children and families shattered by crime. That's why we wanted to bring this special need to your attention. Below, please read a message from James. Thank you.
---
| | [](http://click1.srnemail.com/lndhjnffjldrllcfrddymrqlsjrwnsslknycskdgmzkqnn_qfmffvvsvwsdtmffmmfddnn.html)
---
Dear Friend, Bibles are needed desperately in America's prisons. As I write, many prisoners are struggling with feelings of loneliness, isolation, and despair. But we can reach them with the hope of Jesus Christ by sending as many Bibles as we can, as quickly as we can. [**Will you help with a generous gift today to send Bibles and life-changing Christian content to prisoners?**](http://click1.srnemail.com/clpmclkkcsgfsszkfggntfqsvcfjlvvsdlnzvdgpthdqlj_qfmffvvsvwsdtmffmmfddnn.html) Every gift you give will put Bibles and Christian content into the hands of a waiting prisoner. The demand right now is unlike anything we have ever seen, and there is nothing short of a revival happening behind prison walls! That's why I hope you can [**help by giving your best gift to send Bibles and Christian content into prisons today.**](http://click1.srnemail.com/ufqcnfzznjgsjjkzsggdhsmjvnspfvvjqfdkvqgwhyqmfm_qfmffvvsvwsdtmffmmfddnn.html) With many prisons reopening, we have an amazing opportunity to reach men and women with what they need most: God's Word! Thank you for remembering those in prison. Yours in His service,
---
| | **JAMES J. ACKERMAN** President and Chief Executive Officer

---

Hi Peter,

It's Dr. Ben Carson emailing you.

Before I served in President Trump's administration, I spent three decades as a neurosurgeon helping people reclaim their lives. I've been blessed to reach my potential, but my story almost didn't turn out that way.

You see, I grew up poor in the Detroit area and my parents divorced when I was young. Life was hard and at times we just barely got by, but my mother pushed me to excel in school and reach my potential.

I've lived the American Dream and want to ensure others enjoy its unlimited potential, which is why I am so concerned about the future of this country under the Democrats' leadership.

I'm working with House Republicans to raise $1 million to help conservatives put our country back in good hands and save the American Dream. **[Will you please donate $5, $25, $50, or anything you can today to help us reach our goal?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61062507:JrrsLbVNJ:m:1:3331421248:0F1B64511C60A10B3EFE848789C31123:r "Will you please

body:
https://www.catherineforcongress.com [https://www.catherineforcongress.com]
I grew up here... now I’m asking for your vote
I was born and raised in Westchester. My great grandfather's milk delivery route tracked through Scarsdale and White Plains. After my father abandoned the family when I was just an infant, my mother and grandmother grabbed the reins and provided for our family.
My mother was a public school science teacher in White Plains, my grandmother a nurse. And both of them showed me the meaning of hard work and the rewards that come with it. I got my first job at the age of 13 and haven’t stopped working since. That’s the kind of work ethic you’ll get from me. I won’t stop until I can deliver results.
I know what it's like to struggle. I know what it feels like to look adversity in the eye. I know how you can overcome any challenge, because I’ve gone through my fair share. My experiences have provided me the tools to succeed and I’ve spent a lifetime sharing those tools for others to lift themselves up.
It’s why I’m asking for your vote tomorrow. To send a woman to Washington who believes in the same things you do, who has fought hard for equality and equity within our institutions, and who has a proven track record of delivering results.
When you go vote tomorrow, ask yourself who is the best person to represent your values, fight for your issues, and never stop until we see results. I believe I am that candidate.
Thank you for the incredible support from thousands of residents across this district. It would be the honor of a lifetime to represent you and I cannot wait to get to work.
LFG,
Catherine

My experiences have provided me the tools to succeed and I’ve spent a lifetime sharing those tools for others to lift themselves up. It’s why I’m asking for your vote tomorrow. To send a woman to Washington who believes in the same things you do, who has fought hard for equality and equity within our institutions, and who has a proven track record of delivering results. When you go vote tomorrow, ask yourself who is the best person to represent your values, fight for your issues, and never stop until we see results. I believe I am that candidate. Thank you for the incredible support from thousands of residents across this district. It would be the honor of a lifetime to represent you and I cannot wait to get to work. LFG, Catherine P.S. We are pleased to endorse Dr. Jason Martin for Governor of Tennessee.

We need a leader like Dr. Martin in the top job in the state who truly understands the needs of working families. Tennessee can lead the South on investments in education for every family, improvements to infrastructure, broadband expansion, and protection of our shared environment. Dr. Martin has a bold platform [https://martinfortn.com/issues/] to ensure we lead on all of these issues and more.

Vikram For N.H. Releases Latest T.V. Ad

---
CONCORD, NH - August 22, 2022 - Today, first generation American, businessman, and U.S. Senate candidate Vikram Mansharamani released a bold new T.V. ad entitled Unite in which he describes how the Woke Cultural Revolution is tearing this nation apart. The revolution is seeping through daily life, and leftist leaders and their institutions are looking to divide instead of unify. They are removing statues of our Founding Fathers, hosting segregated graduations based on race and social class, and suggesting kids should choose their own genders. Unification and equality are being replaced with division and equity. Vikram states: "America is being torn apart from an agenda that is pitting people against each other, neighbor vs. neighbor. The situation is grim and I believe we're at a tipping point. We need to arrest this decline into divisive identity politics and I'm optimistic I can lead that charge." Vikram has been on the front lines of the Culture War, having himself been cancelled for being a Republican. It's particularly ironic that the identity-driven Woke revolution turned on Mansharamani, the son of two working-class immigrants from India. "It's particularly disappointing that diversity of skin color is more important than diversity of ideas," he noted. At the end of the ad, Vikram calls for action "to unite this country, not divide it." A significant television buy will accompany this third campaign ad, with a six figure spend on WMUR-Channel 9 and cable.

Hello,
My mother worked alongside my dad in Lebanon Farm Shop well into their 70s. They refused assistance from their many children even after they lost their life savings in the Savings and Loan debacle of the 1980s. My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day.
My dad built a business repairing farm implements. In a way, I think he hoped that I’d stick around and take it over, but that wasn’t to be. I joined the Navy after getting a scholarship and my life as a machinist and welder came to a close.
Dad said very little about his service in the Second World War. He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why.
You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office.
**After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks.**
The early polls all show this will be a close race, so of course, I’m facing down millions of dollars in Super PAC attacks. I don’t come from some political dynasty, and I’m not taking corporate PAC money. Instead, I’m relying entirely on the donations of generous grassroots donors like you.
**There’s less than 24 hours until our next critical fundraising deadline, and right now we’re still short of our $30,000 goal and what we need to defeat Chuck Grassley and win. So I have to ask:**
[**Please, may I count on you to make a donation to my campaign today – before our fundraising deadline? clean_body: My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day. If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please. Hello, My mother worked alongside my dad in Lebanon Farm Shop well into their 70s. They refused assistance from their many children even after they lost their life savings in the Savings and Loan debacle of the 1980s. My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day. My dad built a business repairing farm implements. In a way, I think he hoped that I’d stick around and take it over, but that wasn’t to be. I joined the Navy after getting a scholarship and my life as a machinist and welder came to a close. Dad said very little about his service in the Second World War. He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why. You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office. After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks. The early polls all show this will be a close race, so of course, I’m facing down millions of dollars in Super PAC attacks. I don’t come from some political dynasty, and I’m not taking corporate PAC money. Instead, I’m relying entirely on the donations of generous grassroots donors like you. name: Andy Kim
subject: He worked hard his entire life, and still:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Andy Kim for Congress
body:
It all began with a conversation.
In 2017, I was speaking with residents of a retirement community when one gentleman pulled me aside and, in a troubled whisper, shared that he was paying nearly $500 a month for one life-saving medication.

He resorted to halving his dosage.

He was a proud man, but I could hear a quiver in his voice because he felt terrible that he couldn't support himself and his wife in their golden years.

He said he worked hard for his entire life but couldn't do this alone.

I told him that it wasn't his fault since Big Pharma has been mercilessly running prices up, and Medicare has been unable to negotiate.

I couldn't get it out of my head hours after the conversation ended. How sad is it that folks who work hard are left to fend for themselves in the richest and most powerful nation in the world? Halving their medication.

I knew that it wasn't just this man struggling but hundreds of thousands of seniors like him across the country trying to keep up with the rising cost of prescription drugs.

That day wasn't the last time I heard that story. With each conversation, my resolve to solve this problem grew.

So I co-authored the spending cap provision for those receiving Medicare to $2,000 a year and was proud to vote for it as part of the Inflation Reduction Act. Now, the man I spoke with at the retirement home will pay no more than $166 per month for all of his medication.

Seniors have been waiting too long for these changes. As always, there's more progress to be made, but I'm glad we can finally say we've delivered, and our most vulnerable Americans won't be forced to ration critical medicine.

Andy

name: General Michael Flynn
subject: Who do you want to win: a REAL Trump Republican… or a fraud? 🚨
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kevin Hayslett for Congress
body:
This is General Michael Flynn.
There's not much time before the critical GOP primaries in Florida so I'll make this quick.

| | |

| STATEMENT FROM SENATE REPUBLICAN LEADER ROB ORTT For more than two years, Senate Republicans have been fighting alongside parents and students to end the ridiculous mandates made possible by Governor Hochul's endless COVID-19 Emergency Executive authority. This gubernatorial power-grab has made New York students an outlier, forced to endure senseless restrictions, while their peers across the country return to a normal post-pandemic environment. More and more New Yorkers are beginning to see the danger of One-Party-Rule governance every day. Today's announcement is a long overdue victory for parents and students across New York. I am glad the Governor finally heeded my call to drop COVID restrictions in schools. I now call on her to drop ALL the restrictions and end the emergency today. ###

name: Voice of the Martyrs
subject: When faith is forbidden ...
body:
Meet bold believers in a book that will inspire you to a deeper walk with Christ
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | [](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.net/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiOTgzMDk2NTg1IiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjIyMzQtNjg5OWM1NGJmMGFlNDY2NGIxMTlmMDBiZTBhODdjNDciLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiMCIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vcHhsLmlzdC9zZmt0ZGhldmZlP3NyYz1QTTMwNDI3In0/h3-vE6Gqf1zwEi0bYOhXWw)
---
Dear Friend,

I encourage you to take a 40-day journey through a book that will deepen your faith and may change your life.

You’ll meet a Chinese Christian who called six months in prison “a wonderful time,” an Iraqi pastor who narrowly escaped death after being shot by those opposed to his work, and other men and women —our brothers and sisters in Christ — who have endured great suffering for their faith and witness.

The award-winning book [When Faith Is Forbidden: 40 Days on the Frontlines with Persecuted Christians](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.net/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiOTgzMDk2NTg1IiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjIyMzQtNjg5OWM1NGJmMGFlNDY2NGIxMTlmMDBiZTBhODdjNDciLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiMSIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vcHhsLmlzdC9zZmt0ZGhldmZlP3NyYz1QTTMwNDI3In0/otqxPFC4tfvOPttZsuV_og) will take you on an unforgettable journey to restricted nations and hostile areas to meet believers who boldly live out their Christian faith at great cost.

As you journey through its pages, this book will challenge you to reflect on your own walk with Christ along the sometimes difficult path toward our heavenly home.

Serving our persecuted brothers and sisters and telling their stories is the heartbeat of The Voice of the Martyrs’ ministry. VOM is a nonprofit, interdenominational Christian organization that **serves persecuted Christians on the world’s most difficult and dangerous mission fields**.

Founded in 1967 by Richard and Sabina Wurmbrand, who were themselves imprisoned because of their Christian faith and witness, VOM is dedicated to inspiring believers to deepen their commitment to Christ and to fulfill His Great Commission, no matter the cost.

**We will send you a copy of this outstanding book as our thanks for your online donation to The Voice of the Martyrs.**

| | [ Donate Now](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.net/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiOTgzMDk2NTg1IiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjIyMzQtNjg5OWM1NGJmMGFlNDY2NGIxMTlmMDBiZTBhODdjNDciLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiMiIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vcHhsLmlzdC9zZmt0ZGhldmZlP3NyYz1QTTMwNDI3In0/pHu0HCiUPPS7ixmAh-wfVA)
---

| [](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.net/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiOTgzMDk2NTg1IiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjIyMzQtNjg5OWM1NGJmMGFlNDY2NGIxMTlmMDBiZTBhODdjNDciLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiMyIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vcHhsLmlzdC9zZmt0ZGhldmZlP3NyYz1QTTMwNDI3In0/y3S52PZRaBVM6atvlWZ6CQ)
---

Each stop on this 40-day journey provides inspiration and encouragement through the firsthand accounts of Christians who have endured persecution for the name of Christ.

The book also includes a suggested prayer and space for written reflection as you gain a deeper understanding of persecution against Christians and learn from the examples of faithful believers.

[Make an online donation today and receive this incredible book!](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.net/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiOTgzMDk2NTg1IiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjIyMzQtNjg5OWM1NGJmMGFlNDY2NGIxMTlmMDBiZTBhODdjNDciLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiNCIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vcHhsLmlzdC9zZmt0ZGhldmZlP3NyYz1QTTMwNDI3In0/zCKsD6UjN6_qm35_2EG6Dg)

The book will

* help you learn the truth about Christian persecution
* introduce you to faithful persecuted believers and explain how to help them
* inspire and encourage you through engaging testimonies of God’s faithfulness
* help you pray more specifically for persecuted Christians

I am thrilled to share this powerful resource, which will inform you of the courage and faithfulness of persecuted Christians while inspiring you to stand with them in your own walk of faith.

| | [Donate Now and Receive Your Book](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.net/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiOTgzMDk2NTg1IiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjIyMzQtNjg5OWM1NGJmMGFlNDY2NGIxMTlmMDBiZTBhODdjNDciLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiNSIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vcHhsLmlzdC9zZmt0ZGhldmZlP3NyYz1QTTMwNDI3In0/kgKv80NXTdTwEjOe_A6Low)

Jeremy Burton

clean_body: Meet bold believers in a book that will inspire you to a deeper walk with Christ | | Please see a special message from our sponsor. | | Dear Friend, I encourage you to take a 40-day journey through a book that will deepen your faith and may change your life. You’ll meet a Chinese Christian who called six months in prison “a wonderful time,” an Iraqi pastor who narrowly escaped death after being shot by those opposed to his work, and other men and women —our brothers and sisters in Christ — who have endured great suffering for their faith and witness. The award-winning book will take you on an unforgettable journey to restricted nations and hostile areas to meet believers who boldly live out their Christian faith at great cost. As you journey through its pages, this book will challenge you to reflect on your own walk with Christ along the sometimes difficult path toward our heavenly home. Serving our persecuted brothers and sisters and telling their stories is the heartbeat of The Voice of the Martyrs’ ministry. VOM is a nonprofit, interdenominational Christian organization that serves persecuted Christians on the world’s most difficult and dangerous mission fields. Founded in 1967 by Richard and Sabina Wurmbrand, who were themselves imprisoned because of their Christian faith and witness, VOM is dedicated to inspiring believers to deepen their commitment to Christ and to fulfill His Great Commission, no matter the cost. We will send you a copy of this outstanding book as our thanks for your online donation to The Voice of the Martyrs. | | | Each stop on this 40-day journey provides inspiration and encouragement through the firsthand accounts of Christians who have endured persecution for the name of Christ. The book also includes a suggested prayer and space for written reflection as you gain a deeper understanding of persecution against Christians and learn from the examples of faithful believers. The book will help you learn the truth about Christian persecution introduce you to faithful persecuted believers and explain how to help them inspire and encourage you through engaging testimonies of God’s faithfulness help you pray more specifically for persecuted Christians I am thrilled to share this powerful resource, which will inform you of the courage and faithfulness of persecuted Christians while inspiring you to stand with them in your own walk of faith. | | Jeremy Burton Vice President, Connection The Voice of the Martyrs

#
Hey Derek, I have some BIG news (and it’s not about crudité).
This week I launched a five-step plan to fix our economy and Hold Washington Accountable. 👇
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220822-1?refcode=em20220822-6939&refcode2=6939_434096_GT6vZy&akid=6939%2E434096%2EGT6vZy)
The PlanTM:
Go to Washington as PA’s next U.S. Senator and fight to Make More Sh*t in America, end immoral Price Gouging, cut taxes for working people, slash health care costs, and ban Congress from trading stocks.
I don’t see these as Democratic or Republican solutions. They’re patriotic, pro-America, pro-PA, pro-worker — _and just plain Common Sense. 🇺🇸_
Derek, these are the top issues PA voters care about, and **now that I’m officially back on the campaign trail I need YOUR support to make sure that every last voter in PA learns about my plan to Hold Washington Accountable.**
**[Can you rush a donation of any amount so that I have the resources to talk to as many Pennsylvania voters as possible about my plan to fix our economy and hold Washington accountable once and for all?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220822-1?refcode=em20220822-6939&refcode2=6939_434096_GT6vZy&akid=6939%2E434096%2EGT6vZy)**
**[Contribute $5](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220822-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220822-6939&refcode2=6939_434096_GT6vZy&akid=6939%2E434096%2EGT6vZy)**
Derek, our economy is a mess because the rich + powerful don’t care about PA. They set the rules, weakened our supply chain, and spiked inflation.
They’re too busy sending jobs overseas, ripping off American workers, and eating... crudité.
We need people in DC who actually get it. That’s why I’m proud to release my five-point plan to Hold Washington Accountable, and why your support for our campaign is so critical.
**[If you’re with me, please rush in a donation today so we can spread our plan to every Pennsylvanian and make it reality for all of us.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220822-1?refcode=em20220822-6939&refcode2=6939_434096_GT6vZy&akid=6939%2E434096%2EGT6vZy)**

name: Lucinda Schneller
subject: Brittany needs your help!
body:
Greetings,

Thank you for signing up to get involved through our website! This is going to be a tough race and we need your help to get Brittany's message out to the voters. With less than 80 days before the election on November 8th, Brittany really needs your help!

Canvassing is one of the most effective ways to get Brittany's message out. We will canvass on Saturdays and Sundays from now until Election Day. Canvassing sessions on Saturdays will start at 11am and 2pm and on Sundays at 2pm in Lakewood, Golden, and Conifer. If you've never canvassed before, don't worry! There will be training at each session.

**Lakewood (near 14th & Garrison) signup**: [https://www.mobilize.us/coordinated2022/event/471507/](https://www.mobilize.us/coordinated2022/event/471507/)
**Lakewood (near Jewell & Garrison) signup**: <https://www.mobilize.us/mobilize/event/485725/>
**Conifer signup** : [https://www.mobilize.us/coordinated2022/event/481436/](https://www.mobilize.us/coordinated2022/event/481436/)
**Golden signup** : [https://www.mobilize.us/coordinated2022/event/485721/
](https://www.mobilize.us/coordinated2022/event/485721/)
If weekends aren't good for you, we are canvassing on weekdays in **Lakewood starting at 5 pm on Tuesdays** : <https://www.mobilize.us/mobilize/event/488501/>

If canvassing isn't your thing, we also have virtual phonebanking that you can join from the comfort of your home on Saturdays at 3pm and Tuesdays at 5pm. Again, if you've never phonebanked before, don't worry! We will be training at each session. **Phonebanking signup** : [https://www.mobilize.us/coordinated2022/event/475719/
](https://www.mobilize.us/coordinated2022/event/475719/)

We also have the option to phonebank in person with other volunteers at the **Jeffco Dems office in Lakewood on Thursdays at 6 pm** : <https://www.mobilize.us/mobilize/event/488883/>

Please email or give me a call at 720.254.5741 if you have any questions. Thank you, we can't win this without you! Lucinda
\--

**Lucinda Schneller**
Volunteer Coordinator

Brittany Pettersen for Colorado

720.254.5741

name: Katie Britt
subject: This is why I fight
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Britt for Alabama, Inc
body:
| | | Peter, I'm not sorry.
I'm not sorry for being a momma on a mission and let me tell you why. I'm a mother of two young children who are packing up their new school supplies, grabbing their lunches off the kitchen table, and piling in the car to take on a new school year & all it has to offer. Every year, the night before my son and daughter start a new school year, we pray together as a family. We pray for a year full of endless opportunities, an abundance of learning, and limitless growth. Our children and grandchildren ARE the future of our great nation and we owe it to them to put Alabama first. Wait - I'm jumping ahead, Peter. Let me take a step back and introduce myself. I'm Katie Britt and I'm running for the U.S. Senate because I firmly believe it's time to fight for the next generation and preserve the American Dream for our children. When I first announced I was running for the Senate, I heard reason after reason why I should NOT throw my hat in the ring. But I have two EVEN BIGGER reasons why I decided to block out the noise and dive headfirst into this race: Their names are Bennett and Ridgeway. My school-aged daughter and son who continually remind me "God calls us to do hard things."
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61067457:JkLt2bVNG:m:1:3331421248:449C327CCE235DD59C95CA7B0D8A6812:r)
---
| | **Let me be clear.** My children are my driving force, but this campaign is about EVERY child. From the little ones entering their first day of kindergarten to the high-school seniors day-dreaming about what the future holds - _I 'm fighting for them._ _But, this campaign is also about you. _ _It 's about _**_our_** _children and grandchildren. _ _
__It 's about every student, parent, and family._ _ _ **_It 's about the future of America._** I'll be honest with you, Peter. I never in a MILLION YEARS thought I'd be writing you an email like this, because I never thought that I, a mom of two who became a mother while still putting herself through law school, would be a candidate for the United States Senate. But then again, if anyone knows about persistence and hard work, it's this girl.
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61067457:JkLt2bVNG:m:1:3331421248:449C327CCE235DD59C95CA7B0D8A6812:r)
---
I'm a public school grad from the Wiregrass who watched her parents work six, sometimes seven, days a week just to make ends meet. My dad, my role model, would come home, exhausted from a long day's work, and still make sure to ask me about my school day, what subjects were giving me trouble, and to help me with my math homework and book reports. _My parents gave me a front row seat to watch the American Dream in action_ , and I learned to never take a single day for granted. Beyond that, they taught me what it meant to be my unapologetic self - a devoted Christian, a fearless leader, and a proud conservative. **Let me say that one more time, Peter.** I'm a **devoted Christian** who is dedicated to supporting every child from the womb to the workforce. I'm a **fearless leader** who will stand up for every child, parent, and family. And I'm a **proud conservative** who knows education is the key to opportunity, which is at the heart of the American Dream. Providing children with access to high-quality educational options early is critical to their success later in life.
That is why I strongly believe in school choice: every single Alabama child deserves the best possible education - **regardless of their zip code.**
Peter, you and I both know the jobs of TOMORROW require quality education now, and I am dedicated to supporting Alabama's children TODAY. **[_Our children are going to need every leg up we can give them if we want them to succeed while learning and working in a nation ruled by Radicals like Joe Biden._](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61067457:JkLt2bVNG:m:1:3331421248:449C327CCE235DD59C95CA7B0D8A6812:r) ** Earlier in this email I mentioned I was a _momma on a mission_. That has been my motto since my daughter, Bennett, made me a mother. From that day forward, I lived for my daughter. And then when my son, Ridgeway, came along I lived for them both. I've made every single decision with them in mind, and I will continue to do that every day as a United States Senator. It's my job as a mother to fight tooth and nail for my children. And, if elected in November, I will proudly expand on my role as a momma on a mission and fight for every American child as if they were my own. [_**If you 're able to join me in the fight for our children - and our nation - I hope you'll consider making an immediate contribution of any amount to bolster my campaign. A donation from a fellow conservative like you will make all the difference in this battle for the next generation.**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61067457:JkLt2bVNG:m:1:3331421248:449C327CCE235DD59C95CA7B0D8A6812:r) Thank you in advance for your support,
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61067457:JkLt2bVNG:m:1:3331421248:449C327CCE235DD59C95CA7B0D8A6812:r)
---
Katie Britt Mother of Bennett & Ridgeway Candidate for U.S. Senate
[__P.S. - I 've been a staunch supporter of Alabama's voluntary First Class Pre-K program, which has been ranked as the nation's best for 16 consecutive years, because I know that parents know what's best for their children. We're just starting to send our kids back to school, and there's no better time than RIGHT NOW to make a contribution. Without your donation, I'm afraid we won't have the necessary resources to stand up to Biden and the Radical Left when they try to take away even more choices and opportunities from our innocent children.__](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61067457:JkLt2bVNG:m:1:3331421248:449C327CCE235DD59C95CA7B0D8A6812:r)
---
| |

subject: Jewish leaders speak out about Doug Mastriano
disclaimer_text: Paid for by The Pennsylvania Democratic Party
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90471/images/PDP%20Primary%20Logo.png]
Peter,
On Friday, far-right Florida Governor Ron DeSantis held a rally in Pittsburgh for Republican gubernatorial candidate Doug Mastriano despite repeated calls from Jewish leaders to cancel the rally.
"Doug Mastriano is not a normal Republican candidate for Governor," the Jewish leaders said in their statement.
Jewish leaders also accused DeSantis' plan to rally with Mastriano of "elevating the very extremists spreading disgusting [antisemitic] hate."
We agree — to say the least. After all, Doug has a history of aligning himself with white supremacists and antisemites.
In April, Doug Mastriano's campaign paid Gab, a website harboring white supremacists, $5,000 to get followers [https://www.huffpost.com/entry/doug-mastriano-gab-andrew-torba_n_62d08787e4b02d3ecf3184b9] . This is the same website that empowered the Tree of Life killer to spread antisemitic hate before committing the deadliest antisemitic attack in American history at a Pittsburgh Synagogue.
Mastriano happily accepted [https://www.penncapital-star.com/election-2022/mastriano-gab-voters-torba/] an endorsement from Gab CEO, Andrew Torba, who has his own long history of spreading antisemitism and conspiracy theories.

body:

| |
---
| | | Friend - This is Dr. Oz.

I’ve given out a lot of advice on skincare over my long career. But now I’m asking you to put some skin in the game.

Traveling across Pennsylvania, I’ve heard from thousands of Americans about the daily struggles they face in the Biden era. I’m hearing one thing loud and clear: _addressing those challenges is at the very bottom of Biden’s to-do list._

Instead of focusing on the price of gas, food, and other essentials, Biden and the Democrats are far more concerned about transgender athletes and the Green New Deal.

**NOW** , we’re hearing that my leftist opponent, John Fetterman, thinks the administration hasn’t gone far enough!

We can’t allow John Fetterman to double down on Biden’s failed agenda and lead us further down the road to socialism. That’s why I’m coming to you for help.

---
| | [SQUASH JOHN FETTERMAN'S SOCIALIST AGENDA](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75716%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=mw9iyQJCRk4mH%2fFf0L4IOQ&sysid=1)
---

I decided to run for Senate because I saw an opportunity to give a voice to millions of Americans who have been left behind by Joe Biden. _But now I’m on the front lines in the battle against the rising tide of socialism!_

I’m not afraid of a few leftist agitators, Friend. But I could really use your help in what’s shaping up to be the #1 Senate race in the nation.

**_[Can I count on you to put some skin in the game with a quick $12 contribution to my campaign?](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75717%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=twnrGGVzaE%2bFeyqszoyq3w&sysid=1 "Can I count on you to put some skin in the
game with a quick $12 contribution to my campaign?")_**

---
| | [PUT SOME SKIN IN THE GAME](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75718%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2fH2A7SYxUllCQPU8r6XYwQ&sysid=1)
---

$12 may not seem like much in a race this big. But trust me, Friend, every dollar counts in a race this close.

Thank you for your time,
Dr. Oz

**

**They were arrested, prosecuted, denied bail, and some even thrown into solitary confinement while awaiting trial!
**
Right now, un-American politicians and corrupt members of the Department of Justice are keeping our fellow Americans in jail without due process...they’re often abused and beaten...they’re blocked from seeing their families...and kept from seeing their lawyers!

**[Patriot, please give a vital $5, $10, $25, $50, $100 or more IMMEDIATELY to help fully fund my TWO crucial lawsuits and other hard-hitting legal actions to FREE ALL JANUARY 6 PROTESTERS.

**[Patriot, I’m counting on you for at least a special $25, 50 or more now...but every cent helps. Please give what you can.

Larry Klayman

body:
if Eric Schmitt or John Wood win, they will not stop until they do untold damage to Missouri.
| | |
---
Peter, it's Alex again. I'm Trudy's campaign manager, so you can be sure I want to win this thing. **But before I'm her campaign manager, I am a proud Missourian – born and raised.**
I care _fiercely_ about the future of my beloved state, so I'm going to be blunt with you about what's on the line this November.
**You see, if Eric Schmitt or John Wood win, they will not stop until they have stripped us of our right to choose, degraded our planet for their big oil buddies, and undermined the sanctity of our right to vote.** They will do untold damage to my nation and state, the communities that I love, and families like mine.
I don't want to be an alarmist here, but electing Trudy could not be more critical. **She is the _only_ candidate in this race who cares about the issues that impact the lives of everyday Americans; **issues like accessing affordable and quality healthcare, keeping our kids safe when they are at school, ending the opioid epidemic that is wrecking American families every day, and so much more.
**I know that Trudy is genuinely compassionate, sincere, and kind – and I know she will get the job done in Washington. **That's why I'm all-in on Trudy and this campaign, and why I'm asking you to join me. **[So, Peter, if you're ready to get this job done with us, I need you to rush $5 before our next midnight deadline tonight. name: Harriet Hageman
subject: We did it
body:
| | | | Thank you. |
---

---
Peter,
Today, thanks to your hard work, we did it!

Wyoming has spoken on behalf of everyone all across this great country who believes in the American dream, who believes in liberty, and who recognizes that our natural rights -the freedom of speech, freedom of religion, equal protection and due process, come from God, they do not come from the Government.

And what Wyoming has shown today is that while it may not be easy, we can dislodge entrenched politicians who believe they've risen above the people they're supposed to represent.

| | Hello Peter,

Early voting may be over, but there's still time to vote!

Your vote is your most powerful weapon. Let your voice be heard.

**Mail-in Ballots:**
If you have a mail-in ballot still in your possession, it's likely too late to mail the ballot back in to be counted. At this point, you should **plan to drop off your mail-in ballot in person. All ballots must be received no later than 7 p.m. on Election Day.**

**Election Day:**
On **Tuesday, August 23rd, the polls are open from 7:00AM - 7:00PM.** To find your voting location, click on your county below.

---
| [Escambia County](https://outlook.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5bfd640916a1b05d7592a2dd1&id=af80a6686e&e=9c22e4067b "Escambia County")
---
| [Okaloosa County](https://outlook.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5bfd640916a1b05d7592a2dd1&id=58f8784a56&e=9c22e4067b "Okaloosa County")
---
| [Santa Rosa County](https://outlook.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5bfd640916a1b05d7592a2dd1&id=8a5f0bd97f&e=9c22e4067b "Santa Rosa County")
---
| [Walton County](https://outlook.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5bfd640916a1b05d7592a2dd1&id=44c926dfac&e=9c22e4067b "Walton County")
---
| **The First Congressional District deserves far better representation than it has received from Matt Gaetz.**

You deserve a Congresswoman who will put the needs of the District above self-interest. You deserve a Congresswoman who will devote her time to fighting for the 1st District rather than being on a personal publicity tour over 200 days of the year.

**It's time for meaningful change and I intend to deliver just that. I'd be enormously grateful for your vote on Tuesday.**

Thanks,

body:
I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of A
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zv68203oji185kl2f8hiholpm4lcs47ukrn8uq18_rp22sh2s8i66or4chieco32cdh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq0sjnm6qb6d9le1oj8cbl6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfbcdhmdgm0s3jm2r68cbjmoob5ctncopbcpj4eip7dc70smpmapj0mhimeojgc1jt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6cooj9cr0s1rm6phkc2pm6ptgmlin49fg)
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z4kv5f8v867lnqa1c67i3dcorvkg0bqsnueuue0g_rp22sh2s8i66or4chieco32cdh2bs)

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I 'm telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America - _Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you're thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, "what about them is influential?!"

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren't, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That 's why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America 's black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I'll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zcfnfdf2rc7m44slivsd0qfaud8dj9n09tnsmvng_rp22sh2s8i66or4chieco32cdh2bs)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the "Black Lives Matter" organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn't have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

Now, I'm giving back to the Black community to make sure they don't become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes.

[_**Can you help me reach Black neighborhoods with a message of individualism, freedom, and entrepreneurship? Click here to donate any amount >>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zrf0oos3jautvkoaf93le3gviff2ok7ot1r2tk7g_rp22sh2s8i66or4chieco32cdh2bs)

BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law.

BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them.

BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character.

BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family.

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**Here 's how you can help:**

_I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities_.

This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter.

BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zktcko33mvd08nco5smkra4b6n6gu43l2nk7iga0_rp22sh2s8i66or4chieco32cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zogjji8evs1lea7bv561nkm5l60340rtjt5k3a28_rp22sh2s8i66or4chieco32cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zrsc27krdlo3vi88v7kd6humnb66jomk3pumtsn8_rp22sh2s8i66or4chieco32cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zrs5s6pd3n07ljk9tuh24tm1vq4une1nimnvstoo_rp22sh2s8i66or4chieco32cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zs93h87v9uugef7ji1d2tvkq6itma9q9thp4j0qo_rp22sh2s8i66or4chieco32cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zlmm4ebrmldqkk740g2tf6sb906bik7nhu01gg9o_rp22sh2s8i66or4chieco32cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zp77jogdsnehn70cfq986q2dtgo3s7v9gqvodf4g_rp22sh2s8i66or4chieco32cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zlj8r7hhtkkc5nc659fa0d2luegaj35pbdks6htg_rp22sh2s8i66or4chieco32cdh2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zng9fletc6pu3nr11jacgl99ufj9j6c8v5g5lei8_rp22sh2s8i66or4chieco32cdh2bs)

**HOW BLEXIT Works**

**Step One:** We enter communities no one else dares to go into - Detroit, Baltimore, New Orleans, Houston, etc. We host events and set up chapters of volunteers who build a support network and help get our message of individualism and empowerment to Black neighborhoods.

**Step Two:** We send the best volunteers and chapter members to our Leadership Academy.

We build leaders from the ground up. In fact, our staff is full of stories of activists we hired from the Leadership Academy. They started as a chapter member and now work for us full time.

Other members graduate from the Leadership Academy, and then they go back into their communities to support others or start their own businesses.

As you can see, we are BUILDING neighborhoods, NOT destroying them.

**Step Three:** Our educational content, both online and in-person, is teaching Black communities ideas they will never hear in the mainstream media.

BLEXIT is teaching about individualism, pro-life, school choice, teaching REAL history (not Critical Race Theory), and creating patriotism among Black families.

**Step Four:** We host large events with hundreds, sometimes thousands of attendees. Our events bring music, live entertainment, and education to Black communities.

What I really want to emphasize is this - BLEXIT is a "DO" tank! We are out there meeting people in neighborhoods.

Friend, this is deeply personal for me as a Black man.

We have to save our communities. We must save our country from the toxic and divisive organizations like BLM that are tearing down our businesses and livelihoods.

**So, please, I implore you to send any amount you generously can. We are a 501(c)(3) organization, and your support is tax-deductible. **

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zb576ni8g0bmf42ao6qmqsa6996cm1iuci3el0u8_rp22sh2s8i66or4chieco32cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z1roivfpv7jnjhq4pmumr2njnk2c2549lsqpdgc8_rp22sh2s8i66or4chieco32cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z0nm0ofee4gtuac4ojdi3h0u2mp4jiq6hn120sag_rp22sh2s8i66or4chieco32cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z14d8u35qhi2aj5ausfmma2g6i9srlohdvrd7mbg_rp22sh2s8i66or4chieco32cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zg3svlujlsidsql9v4igo1smq8oo6p67nk418vu8_rp22sh2s8i66or4chieco32cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zfjk89hngsbcvh0hvrs3ms1gn9p7peprpne16s80_rp22sh2s8i66or4chieco32cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z60frgn4t9erk049g3r4l18haa0rfu4m1j1omgbo_rp22sh2s8i66or4chieco32cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zk9dejf50bka0h115k3rd1clbv0p143endsn0lo8_rp22sh2s8i66or4chieco32cdh2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zet0gk2bfnnak51ce99q2n1rr33qudn4kdl7lhp0_rp22sh2s8i66or4chieco32cdh2bs)

People ask me, "What does BLEXIT mean?"

It is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us.

_" If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim, you become your own oppressor." \- Candace Owens_

We believe in Faith, Freedom, and Family. With those three principles intact, you can find prosperity no matter how your life may have started. And I believe that is what will save us all in the end.

Thank you,

Brandon Tatum
Co-Founder
BLEXIT Foundation

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jared Moskowitz for Congress
body:
Polls are open 7AM-7PM

https://jaredforflorida.com/ [https://jaredforflorida.com/]
Dear Friends,
First of all, I want to thank everyone who has already voted early or by mail. I’m incredibly grateful for your support.
If you have not already voted, tomorrow is Election Day. Please make a plan to vote or return your vote-by-mail ballot in person. Here is some additional county-specific information:
Palm Beach: To find your polling location, click here. [https://www.pbcelections.org/Voters/Election-Day-Voting] If you still have your vote-by-mail ballot, deliver it to the Supervisor of Elections office. Click here for locations and hours. [https://www.pbcelections.org/Voters/Vote-By-Mail] Alternatively, you can bring your un-returned vote-by-mail ballot to your assigned election day voting location. There, poll workers will cancel your vote-by-mail ballot and instead provide you with an in-person ballot on election day.
Broward: To find your polling location, click here. [https://www.browardvotes.gov/Voter-Information/Precinct-Finder] If you still have your vote-by-mail ballot, deliver it to the Supervisor of Elections office at 1501 NW 40th Avenue, Lauderhill, FL 33313.
https://jaredforflorida.com/ [https://jaredforflorida.com/]
I’ve learned so much from the conversations I’ve had with so many of you, and I appreciate the opportunity to earn your support.
And I’m more committed than ever to taking the fight for our values to Washington. That means protecting abortion rights, ending gun violence, tackling inflation, and defending our democracy from right-wing attacks.
Your support is critical to winning these battles and delivering real change for our community and our country. So please make a plan to vote tomorrow and make your voice heard!
Let’s finish strong tomorrow and get ready to win in November!
Warmly,
Jared Moskowitz

name: Kristina Karamo
subject: An Evening at Bedminster
body:
We had an exciting Tuesday night when President Trump hosted a fundraiser for Kristina at Trump National in Bedminster, NJ! Supporters from across the country came to meet Kristina and hear her message of restoring the rule of law to the Secretary of State's office.

It was a wonderful evening and we are happy to share some photos with you.

It’s crunch time. ** ** November is getting closer and closer, and Democrats are getting more and more desperate. They know we have a group of candidates who could demolish their majority. # All across America parents are losing custody of their children to Biden-Wes Moore-style gender/sex indoctrination and state overreach.

And Moore wants less parental control, less SRO intervention, more state database tracking of students, and more sexualized political groups accessing your kids in schools. That's dangerous for the future of Maryland and our families, children and grandchildren.
_Help me stop him here in Maryland._

|
#### Dear friend of Maryland,

Last month, I became Maryland’s Republican nominee for governor, and I could not have succeeded without your generous support of time, effort, and money! Thank you again!

Now I need your help to win this fall. Mail-in ballots begin in less than 45 days and the election for Maryland Governor is in **exactly 78 days.**

Our first financial report deadline is only about 24 hours away.

My opponent Wes Moore has a dim future planned for Marylanders, including ushering in President Biden’s failed economic policies we are seeing unfold on the national stage, raising taxes on struggling middle-class families in a time of recession, and a radical wealth redistribution scheme determined to divide Marylanders based on their race and gender.

**If you think that’s bad, wait until you read his plan to indoctrinate our children behind our backs. The screenshots in this e-mail are from his website _right now._

While I have pledged to restore parental control of education and expand school choice, Wes Moore has pledged to double-down on the Biden-DOJ "parents are domestic terrorists" plan, and will indoctrinate your kids including:**
* tracking all students in the state database called the "longitudinal data" system - a socialist government control practice. (see attached).

* limit SROs (school resource/safety officers) from certain work in schools (see attached)

* forcing politics in the classroom in the form of divisive CRT ("trauma-informed") and "gender equality" for Pre-K through 12th grade - without parental knowledge of the curriculum or option to op-out all while "partnering with [politically idealogical] organizations" to "provide tools" (see attached).

####
**And if parents disagree with the gender indoctrination they could face the removal of their children like what is happening now in[California](https://coxforfreedom.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=f512e75194&e=5bb5efcda7)****,[ Chicago](https://coxforfreedom.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=e9f5f5917c&e=5bb5efcda7) and even [Texas](https://coxforfreedom.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=d6495bf86f&e=5bb5efcda7). Even on Wes Moore's website (graphic above) he admits that state foster care has higher rates of children who believe they are transgender. His policies will make this worse. State custody removal of children is one way that children end up in foster care.**

Watch this [heartbreaking video](https://coxforfreedom.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=862e07cec7&e=5bb5efcda7) of a Los Angeles mom who lost custody of her daughter to the state because she wouldn't agree to gender altering surgeries and medications. Then, after the state took her away from her mother and prevented contact, her daughter threw herself in front a train. Emotionally distraught, the mother said "They killed my daughter! They had to pick pieces of her up off the train tracks."

**Help me take a stand against the destructive policies Wes Moore and his Biden-agenda has in store for us all.**

**Join me in the fight. It’s now or never. **

Dan Cox
Republican Nominee for Maryland Governor

name: Katie Britt
subject: I’m on a mission
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Britt for Alabama, Inc
body:
| | | Peter, I'm not sorry.
I'm not sorry for being a momma on a mission and let me tell you why. I'm a mother of two young children who are packing up their new school supplies, grabbing their lunches off the kitchen table, and piling in the car to take on a new school year & all it has to offer. Every year, the night before my son and daughter start a new school year, we pray together as a family. We pray for a year full of endless opportunities, an abundance of learning, and limitless growth. Our children and grandchildren ARE the future of our great nation and we owe it to them to put Alabama first. Wait - I'm jumping ahead, Peter. Let me take a step back and introduce myself. I'm Katie Britt and I'm running for the U.S. Senate because I firmly believe it's time to fight for the next generation and preserve the American Dream for our children. When I first announced I was running for the Senate, I heard reason after reason why I should NOT throw my hat in the ring. But I have two EVEN BIGGER reasons why I decided to block out the noise and dive headfirst into this race: Their names are Bennett and Ridgeway. My school-aged daughter and son who continually remind me "God calls us to do hard things."

name: American Update
subject: The Great Reset and socialism
body:
A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0673%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=AXE%2fSTnGvt4AsOV87I1LSA&sysid=1)
| | | This sponsored message from American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c31088%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=oyTg13WnQA%2bqZslT7BWlNA&sysid=1)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ --Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty--author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’--a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for--and opposition to--socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c31089%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=XYlrmJHY20C5Z9%2bpC7d%2b3w&sysid=1)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. ** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”--including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory--which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race--are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly. ** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c31089%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=XYlrmJHY20C5Z9%2bpC7d%2b3w&sysid=1)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember--**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

Friend -- Please forgive the quick note, as I'm about to head back out for Air National Guard duty, but I want to take a minute to leave you with both encouragement and a challenge. A lot of you have written to me lamenting Liz Cheney's loss in Wyoming -- and yes, its a sad reflection of what the Republican Party has become. But there IS a bright side: Liz and I both will have A LOT more time to fulfill a mission much bigger than re-election: **Saving Democracy, Solving Problems, and Ensuring Donald Trump and his Disciples will never again control America.** Country First is how we can all do that -- together. | [](https://www.country1st.com/donate?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=catch_up_nd&n=2 "Support Our Critical Mission") [Support Our Critical Mission](https://www.country1st.com/donate?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=catch_up_nd&n=2)
---
This movement is for the **Reasonable Majority** \-- made up of folks from all parties and of none -- and what binds this unlikely alliance together is our recognition that we will never achieve real, durable solutions unless we work together, and defeat those standing in the way.
Solutions that foster opportunity for ALL, safe and secure neighborhoods, great schools, and a stable climate. Solutions that leave our kids and grandkids a better America than we inherited. Solutions that don't belong to one party or political faction.
For the rest of this year we'll be focused on supporting leaders who LEAD; leaders who put our country before party; leaders who break the cycle of extremism. **And I'll be proud to support good Democrats, good Republicans, and good Independents who are focused on that shared mission** \-- stay tuned!
Friend, the fight we're in right now is bigger than party, it's bigger than personality, it's bigger than policy. This is an opportunity for the Reasonable Majority to stand up together to save and strengthen democracy, OR we can stay stuck and divided in our comfortable tribes while the country slips away to authoritarianism.
**I've made my choice. So has Liz.** America needs you; she needs all of us. So thank you for rising to the occasion, thanks for your support, and thanks for spreading the word. We can't do it without you.
Country First,
Adam

Solutions that don't belong to one party or political faction. For the rest of this year we'll be focused on supporting leaders who LEAD; leaders who put our country before party; leaders who break the cycle of extremism. And I'll be proud to support good Democrats, good Republicans, and good Independents who are focused on that shared mission \-- stay tuned! Friend, the fight we're in right now is bigger than party, it's bigger than personality, it's bigger than policy. This is an opportunity for the Reasonable Majority to stand up together to save and strengthen democracy, OR we can stay stuck and divided in our comfortable tribes while the country slips away to authoritarianism. I've made my choice. So has Liz. America needs you; she needs all of us. So thank you for rising to the occasion, thanks for your support, and thanks for spreading the word. Kevin McCarthy and his allies would try to, among other things, enact a nationwide ban on abortion, roll back voting rights, and undo progress we’ve made to both combat climate change and build an economy that works for both working people and small business.
We know this would be devastating. But this is precisely the stakes of this election. **[So we're reaching out to you to ask: Can you please donate $5 or as much as possible to keep PA-06 blue?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49593119/362739741/-256290429?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk652-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNjUzYzlmNC01MjIyLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yx0KToCaNwWqafhB1Jh9AjrMi8YpKsec-oUv_FVqEpo=)**

subject: I have nothing to apologize for

body:
| | | Peter, I'm not sorry.
I'm not sorry for being a momma on a mission and let me tell you why. I'm a mother of two young children who are packing up their new school supplies, grabbing their lunches off the kitchen table, and piling in the car to take on a new school year & all it has to offer. Every year, the night before my son and daughter start a new school year, we pray together as a family. We pray for a year full of endless opportunities, an abundance of learning, and limitless growth. Our children and grandchildren ARE the future of our great nation and we owe it to them to put Alabama first. Wait - I'm jumping ahead, Peter. Let me take a step back and introduce myself. I'm Katie Britt and I'm running for the U.S. Senate because I firmly believe it's time to fight for the next generation and preserve the American Dream for our children. When I first announced I was running for the Senate, I heard reason after reason why I should NOT throw my hat in the ring. But I have two EVEN BIGGER reasons why I decided to block out the noise and dive headfirst into this race: Their names are Bennett and Ridgeway. My school-aged daughter and son who continually remind me "God calls us to do hard things."
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61067408:JbQewbVeN:m:1:3253819041:D182893B6B762E60CFB3D3F17C932A6C:r)
---
| | **Let me be clear.** My children are my driving force, but this campaign is about EVERY child. From the little ones entering their first day of kindergarten to the high-school seniors day-dreaming about what the future holds - _I 'm fighting for them._ _But, this campaign is also about you. _ _It 's about _**_our_** _children and grandchildren. __
__It 's about every student, parent, and family.__ _**_It 's about the future of America._** I'll be honest with you, Peter. I never in a MILLION YEARS thought I'd be writing you an email like this, because I never thought that I, a mom of two who became a mother while still putting herself through law school, would be a candidate for the United States Senate. But then again, if anyone knows about persistence and hard work, it's this girl.
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61067408:JbQewbVeN:m:1:3253819041:D182893B6B762E60CFB3D3F17C932A6C:r)
---
I'm a public school grad from the Wiregrass who watched her parents work six, sometimes seven, days a week just to make ends meet. My dad, my role model, would come home, exhausted from a long day's work, and still make sure to ask me about my school day, what subjects were giving me trouble, and to help me with my math homework and book reports. _My parents gave me a front row seat to watch the American Dream in action_ , and I learned to never take a single day for granted. Beyond that, they taught me what it meant to be my unapologetic self - a devoted Christian, a fearless leader, and a proud conservative. **Let me say that one more time, Peter.** I'm a **devoted Christian** who is dedicated to supporting every child from the womb to the workforce. I'm a **fearless leader** who will stand up for every child, parent, and family. And I'm a **proud conservative** who knows education is the key to opportunity, which is at the heart of the American Dream. Providing children with access to high-quality educational options early is critical to their success later in life.
That is why I strongly believe in school choice: every single Alabama child deserves the best possible education - **regardless of their zip code.**
Peter, you and I both know the jobs of TOMORROW require quality education now, and I am dedicated to supporting Alabama's children TODAY. **[_Our children are going to need every leg up we can give them if we want them to succeed while learning and working in a nation ruled by Radicals like Joe Biden._](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61067408:JbQewbVeN:m:1:3253819041:D182893B6B762E60CFB3D3F17C932A6C:r) ** Earlier in this email I mentioned I was a _momma on a mission_. That has been my motto since my daughter, Bennett, made me a mother. From that day forward, I lived for my daughter. And then when my son, Ridgeway, came along I lived for them both. I've made every single decision with them in mind, and I will continue to do that every day as a United States Senator. It's my job as a mother to fight tooth and nail for my children. And, if elected in November, I will proudly expand on my role as a momma on a mission and fight for every American child as if they were my own. [_**If you 're able to join me in the fight for our children - and our nation - I hope you'll consider making an immediate contribution of any amount to bolster my campaign. A donation from a fellow conservative like you will make all the difference in this battle for the next generation.**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61067408:JbQewbVeN:m:1:3253819041:D182893B6B762E60CFB3D3F17C932A6C:r) Thank you in advance for your support,
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61067408:JbQewbVeN:m:1:3253819041:D182893B6B762E60CFB3D3F17C932A6C:r)
---
Katie Britt Mother of Bennett & RidgewayCandidate for U.S. Senate
[__P.S. - I 've been a staunch supporter of Alabama's voluntary First Class Pre-K program, which has been ranked as the nation's best for 16 consecutive years, because I know that parents know what's best for their children. We're just starting to send our kids back to school, and there's no better time than RIGHT NOW to make a contribution. Without your donation, I'm afraid we won't have the necessary resources to stand up to Biden and the Radical Left when they try to take away even more choices and opportunities from our innocent children.__](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61067408:JbQewbVeN:m:1:3253819041:D182893B6B762E60CFB3D3F17C932A6C:r)
