My dad, my role model, would come home, exhausted from a long day's work, and still make sure to ask me about my school day, what subjects were giving me trouble, and to help me with my math homework and book reports. My parents gave me a front row seat to watch the American Dream in action , and I learned to never take a single day for granted. Beyond that, they taught me what it meant to be my unapologetic self - a devoted Christian, a fearless leader, and a proud conservative. Let me say that one more time, Peter. I'm a devoted Christian who is dedicated to supporting every child from the womb to the workforce. I'm a fearless leader who will stand up for every child, parent, and family. And I'm a proud conservative who knows education is the key to opportunity, which is at the heart of the American Dream. Providing children with access to high-quality educational options early is critical to their success later in life. That is why I strongly believe in school choice: every single Alabama child deserves the best possible education - regardless of their zip code. Peter, you and I both know the jobs of TOMORROW require quality education now, and I am dedicated to supporting Alabama's children TODAY. Earlier in this email I mentioned I was a momma on a mission_. That has been my motto since my daughter, Bennett, made me a mother. From that day forward, I lived for my daughter. And then when my son, Ridgeway, came along I lived for them both. I've made every single decision with them in mind, and I will continue to do that every day as a United States Senator. It's my job as a mother to fight tooth and nail for my children. And, if elected in November, I will proudly expand on my role as a momma on a mission and fight for every American child as if they were my own. Thank you in advance for your support, Katie Britt Mother of Bennett & RidgewayCandidate for U.S. Senate | | Paid for by Britt for Alabama, Inc. subject: 87,000 new workers to the IRS
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jim Jordan for Congress
body:
We missed our goal of finding 8,700 conservatives to sign our "Stop the IRS Petition" last week. We need your help to make sure that we hit our goal before this Friday.

| Last week, my team and I began to circulate a petition for which we were hoping to gather 8,700 signatures. The petition calls for the $80 billion recently allocated by the Democrats to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to be spent on a better cause, such as hiring 87,000 new border patrol agents.

**We didn't meet our goal, which is why I'm writing today. There is no scenario in which the federal government needs to hire 87,000 new IRS agents. None.**

If you missed taking a moment to sign my petition the first time it was sent around last week, **[please take a moment to sign it today.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61068011:J6jEvbVNc:m:1:3331421248:528D410B2BED1A572AB50BA87C201BEB:r)**

You can find the original email below for reference. Thanks,
Jim

\-----------------------------------------------

From: Jim Jordan
Date: Thu, Aug 18, 2022 at 11:33 AM
Subject: Help me stop the IRS
dpwillis67@gmail.com

Peter,

Can I give you yet another reason why Republicans need to take back the House in November?

**The same Democrat party that just authorized the unprecedented FBI raid of President Trump's home over "documents" just voted to give the IRS enough of your hard-earned money to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to come after the rest of us**.

**In what world is 87,000 new IRS agents a priority for our country?**

Sure, the Democrats claim they are just trying to squeeze every possible penny they can out of the American people to fund Biden's dangerous agenda.**But I think there is much, much more to this power grab.**

**Ask yourself this:** __Why not use that same $80 billion to hire 87,000 new border patrol agents instead? Better yet, why not let people keep their own hard-earned money for themselves and their families?__

**Please let me know if I can count on you as an ally in the effort to stop the Biden/Pelosi agenda that is taking our money, our freedom, and our country.[I'm asking you to be among 8,700 conservatives to sign a petition to stop the government funding for the 87,000 new IRS agents. Can I count on your signature between now and Friday.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61068011:J6jEvbVNc:m:1:3331421248:528D410B2BED1A572AB50BA87C201BEB:r)**

[** SIGN MY IRS PETITION BEFORE FRIDAY **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61068011:J6jEvbVNc:m:1:3331421248:528D410B2BED1A572AB50BA87C201BEB:r)
**Yes, showering the IRS with funds is about Democrats wanting more of our hard-earned money.** But to me, it's just as much about the fundamental choice that Americans have faced since our founding. disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jon Kaiman for Congress
body:
Peter,
Our district deserves leaders with experience who are ready on day one to advocate for our community. As Americans, we have the power to send **tested** and **trusted** leaders to represent us in Washington - leaders **who will fight for what we believe in**. Tomorrow **you have the power** to change the course of history and make your mark on this country by supporting a candidate who will strive to make this country a better place to live and work.

Jon Kaiman has unrivaled experience in delivering results for our community. He has secured and deployed millions of dollars in federal funding for infrastructure, community investment, environmental mitigation, and preserving and protecting the quality of life of the residents of Long Island. Jon launched the 311 Call Center and performance management system in the Town of North Hempstead, created Project Independence to help seniors age in place, and uplifted communities in distress while investing in the arts, the environment, local neighborhoods, parks and roads, and government services.

Now Jon is running to represent our community in the United States Congress as the Democratic candidate who will fight to protect the rights of women, to protect our environment from climate change, to keep us safe in our homes and neighborhoods, to end gun violence, and to preserve the democratic institutions that form the foundation of American democracy.

**With your vote tomorrow, you can make your mark on American history.**

As you are likely aware, the Democrats passed, and Biden signed into law, their horrible spending, taxation, and social engineering bill. One part of this bill authorizes 87,000 new IRS agents. Democrats promise they won’t be used to harass opponents or bother small businesses or families making under $400,000 (as if harassing those making more won’t also harm the country). Having personal experience with the IRS being weaponized by Obama and the targeting of tea party groups, we know better than to trust the Democrats. | | Many states have [improved their election integrity laws](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-Q) over the past year, reports the Heritage Foundation in its Election Integrity [Scorecard](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1Njk3JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/hiwm1DCvOFIzFJ5mf5-qWw). That’s encouraging news and confirmation that your vote does count. Still, many challenges remain. With three months remaining before the election, Illinois is already [mailing ballots to voters](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-rFyClAwaSrNy2GGbKiTg). The state’s new vote-by-mail law allows voters the option of receiving mail-in ballots on a permanent basis. Residents can even apply online to vote by mail. Ensuring election integrity can be daunting, as even woke Starbucks is discovering. Last week, [Starbucks requested that the National Labor Relations Board suspend all mail-in ballots](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) in union elections nationwide, alleging election chicanery between NLRB personnel and the union that’s attempting to unionize its baristas. Ultimately, safeguarding election integrity will boil down to finding honest patriots like you who are willing to [serve as poll workers and poll watchers](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1Njk3JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/haY-49s9TNcjr35ahPEz9A) – positions that in the past have been overwhelmingly held by left-wing activists.
---
| | |
---
|
---
[](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-7mV6wC_tU7XkQ)
---
** URGENT: SIGN UP TO BE POLL WORKER OR WATCHER** In nearly every county in the U.S., these election positions have historically been held by left-wing activists. _Patriots must be a part of the process going forward!_ If you’re wondering which is better, poll worker (also called election worker, officer of election, election judge, etc. in different places) is preferable. Poll watchers are much more limited in what they are able to do, while workers have actual power to make decisions that matter, in most cases. And they get paid a lot of the time! So, if you have a choice, it is better to be a worker than a watcher, but being a watcher is better than nothing! **Deadlines are fast approaching for the November election, so please sign up today!** The [**U.S. Election Assistance Commission has a handy tool**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.org/c/7/eyJhaSI6NDkxMDk0ODksImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiVDE4bzlMbmV1akhoazkxUVFRIiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjIyMzQtZjNkYTk3M2Q0MDgwNGVjYmFjNmU1MmE1NGNlZTQwMTEiLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiOSIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LmVhYy5nb3YvaGVscC1hbWVyaWNhLXZvdGU_bWlkPTQ1Njk3JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/460YKNdhj8X9pIbtW4X4yA) to find out how to become a poll worker/watcher in your state and county. Just scroll down to the **Poll Worker Recruitment Lookup Tool** and select your state. They also have [**a document that lists all of the requirements for serving as a poll worker**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) on a state-by-state basis, so you can use that to see if you meet the requirements. Also, many states allow teenagers (i.e., 16 and up) to serve as poll workers or watchers, so if you know any high-schoolers who would want to serve in this way, invite them to sign up too! **Additionally, if you are interested in working with other patriots to build out permanent election integrity infrastructure in your state and in your county,**[**please fill out this form**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)**, and we will be in touch with you.** The reason the left is so far ahead in this arena is because they have permanent infrastructure when it comes to elections. Now, it’s our turn. And, if you didn’t watch [my CPAC speech](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-3iNJdAwi9nY7AHw) about election integrity last week, take a look!

| | Now that the Democrats’ new spending bill has been approved by Congress and signed into law, Texas cattle ranchers [David and Deborah Hajda have a warning](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1Njk3JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/hNgxOke26i6-W1LzBvyomQ) for Americans about what they can expect from a provision that adds an additional [$80 billion for IRS funding](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.), more than half of which is [targeted toward enforcement efforts](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-EBriOefmA). “We got audited over basically a $7,800 engine rebuild on a very old tractor,” Deborah said of an incident that occurred 13 years ago. They turned over all the expense records and receipts, yet the auditor persisted. “He kept digging, and he ended up nailing us,” David said. “Our tax person was giving us 80% on our work vehicles, and he said you can only do 50%.” In 2021, 51% of all IRS audits were of individuals making less than $75,000 a year. According to Steven Hayes, chairman and president of Fair Tax, the [IRS targets people who make “minimal income”](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._AcSKk3CEfnjpTmNr_eyfQ) because they “can’t afford to fight it and probably don’t have the skills to fight it, so it’s very easy picking.” If the IRS expanded it auditing activities by just 10%, that would necessitate [140,000 more Americans dedicated to keeping the IRS at bay](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1Njk3JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/XmbfjU6rhW7s7OYriNIS2g) instead of contributing to the economy. America’s families and businesses already spend [6.5 billion hours](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._gWUg) a year on federal tax paperwork, according to Office of Management and Budget figures. Isn’t it worth some of your time between now and November to help Tea Party Patriots Action reverse this invasion of America’s households?

clean_body: We had to pull our ads off the air, so Raphael Warnock has the airwaves to himself in the race that will determine control of the Senate. | Peter, I had hoped it wouldn't come to this, but I'd prefer to be the one to tell you rather than let the Democrats leak the news to the mainstream media. As a result of the tough fundraising environment Republicans are seeing across the nation, we're not raising enough money to run the campaign that we need to be running. As of last week, our ads are no longer running across Georgia. Meanwhile, our opponent Raphael Warnock has more cash than he knows what to do with. He has more than $22 million in the bank and is raising MILLIONS MORE each WEEK. While our campaign doesn't have the money to keep our ads running, Raphael Warnock could run ads for the next 11 weeks without raising another dollar. I need your help. The more money we raise today, the sooner we can get back on the air. It takes $2 million per week to run TV ads across Georgia. * * *
**Q: I'm worried by the GOP's all-out assault on women's rights. What can we do to fight back?** Great question. The war on women's & reproductive rights is urgent, and it's already having dire consequences for people in Texas and across the country. Turning the tide won't be easy, but it is possible. Our two most important tasks are **expanding our Senate majority** and **limiting the power of the right-wing extremists on the Supreme Court**. Then we can secure women's rights in several ways — passing legislation to codify protections, and fight for Court reform in Congress. **Q: Republicans recently voted overwhelmingly against veterans' healthcare. They also voted to kill legislation that would have capped the price of insulin at just $35/month. Why?** Unfortunately, despite all of the GOP talking points about taking care of our veterans and our working people, we have to face the truth. **The vast majority of Republicans in Congress are not fighting for everyday Americans.** Time and time again, they have sold out our heroes in uniform in favor of billionaire CEOs and corporate profits. **Q: Where are we in the fight against gun violence?** I'm glad you asked. A little more than a month ago, **President Biden signed into law the most significant gun safety legislation in nearly three decades**. I was proud to champion this bill, and to vote for it in the House. It's a great start, and it will save lives, but there's more work to be done. Ending the gun violence epidemic will always be one of my top priorities in Congress. **Q: Are we still working toward immigration reform?** Yes! Although it doesn’t always get media coverage, I’ve been working hard to sponsor and co-sponsor bills that address various challenges of our broken immigration system. From making our processing practices more efficient, to investing in our ports of entry, to making sure our handling of migrants is humane, there’s movement happening. Finding long-term solutions to address the root causes of migration and how we respond won’t be quick, but** I’m committed to my promise to work with anyone who is willing to help us reach these goals**. **Q: I’m really concerned about voting rights. What are you doing about this?** Good question. The voting rights bill, among hundreds of other bills, is currently being blocked by Senate Republicans. **House Democrats passed legislation to protect rights, make Election Day a national holiday, expand mail-in voting, and much more**. We need to expand our majority in the Senate to see it pass. Until then, my campaign is working to register new voters and run a voter hotline in El Paso to help those confused or impacted by the Texas suppression law. **Q: Is Social Security going to run out?** The number one issue I’m hearing from seniors is concerns about Social Security and making ends meet, and I understand. That's why **I'm a proud co-sponsor of the Social Security 2100 Act** , which will boost Medicare for seniors, provide them tax relief, and expand benefits for current and future recipients. Republicans have said they’d like to end social security. As long as I’m elected, I’ll fight to protect and expand the program. **Q: How can I convince my friends to vote?** Tell them what’s at stake this November. It’s voting rights, Social Security, women’s healthcare, everything above, and so much more. Then, tell them why you’re passionate about these topics. We have an opportunity to elect great leaders. **All 435 House seats, 34 Senate seats, and 36 Governors are up for election this November.** Electing the best people to those positions starts with one vote.

Decades of inaction have led to one of Nevada’s – and our country’s – greatest natural resources dropping to historic levels due to unprecedented drought. The Southwest relies on the health of Lake Mead for agricultural and survival purposes. It’s a major source of irrigation and drinking water for millions of people and we need to do all we can to protect it. = | | | = I remember Lake Mead a lot differently, folks. Just 20 years ago, it was blue waters for as far as the eye can see. Now, receding water levels are revealing boats, car parts, and lost personal belongings from decades back. Climate change is real, it’s the main reason why we’re experiencing drought, there’s no denying it at this point and it certainly isn’t rocket science. This is a matter of keeping our state habitable for generations to come and Nevada deserves better than silence from their Republican candidate. I’ll be blunt: A 50/50 Senate is not cutting it. If we want to make meaningful progress, our only choice is to expand the majority.
So I’m joining forces with Mandela Barnes, Val Demings, John Fetterman and Tim Ryan as “The Flippable Five” to make sure that we get this done in November.
Our races are Democrats’ five best chances to flip a seat this year, and each of us is fully committed to ending the filibuster and making the Senate work for families across this country.
[**Can you please split a $5 donation between Mandela Barnes, Val Demings, John Fetterman, Tim Ryan and my campaign today to flip these Senate seats and expand our majority?**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-flippablefive.U99Ie8&refcode=em220822-1-ma&t=1&akid=1521%2E357359%2E5rrT4Z)

The truth is we cannot win in North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Wisconsin or Florida without a LOT of grassroots support.
Each of us is taking on a Trump-endorsed opponent backed by millions in outside spending. All of our opponents praised the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , and if given the chance, they will pass a nationwide abortion ban.
It’s incredibly clear that our status quo is broken, and politicians in Washington will do everything they can to preserve it. But if we flip these five seats, it would be transformative for families across our country. Imagine the progress we can make on voting rights, climate, reproductive freedom and more.
But it is going to be tough. These races will be decided by incredibly small margins, and Republicans are spending big to try to stop each of us. So I am personally asking, on behalf of all of us, for your support today:

It was love at first sight. Since then, I’ve seen Brittany fight for regular people with everything she’s got in the State House and Senate— working well into the night (okay that part wasn’t always great) to pass laws to help our schools, reduce health care costs, and protect Coloradans’ civil rights. body:
We need Eric Toney

Friend – Attorney General Josh Kaul has failed to support law enforcement, enforce our election laws, and protect Wisconsin from violent criminals. As chaos ensued in Kenosha, he let the community go up in flames. As millions of lethal doses of fentanyl cross the southern border and through Wisconsin, he is complacent. Josh Kaul’s leadership has been marked by disappointment at every turn. As Wisconsin works through a striking level of lawlessness and uncertainty, we need a top cop we can trust to keep our communities safe. One person is up to the job, and it’s Eric Toney. A tough, no-nonsense prosecutor, Eric Toney is dedicated to restoring safety and security to our communities, law enforcement, and elections. The son of a law enforcement officer, he understands the ways our police put their lives on the line every day to protect our communities; he is without a doubt law enforcement’s choice for Attorney General. Friend, if we want to make Wisconsin safe again, we’ll need Eric Toney to do it. Will you join our fight and help make Eric Toney Wisconsin’s next Attorney General? # [#]I want to introduce you to Josh Lafazan, a Democrat running for Congress on Long Island — in the very competitive Third District of New York.

How competitive? Cook Political Report has rated it a “Toss Up,” one of a handful of seats across the country that will determine the majority in Congress.

Election Day in New York is on Tuesday, and I’m asking you to donate right now to power Josh Lafazan to victory. Here’s why: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jg-lafazan-split-2208?amount=10]

He’s the only sitting elected official in the race and the only one who’s consistently won elections in divided districts. In fact, Josh’s leading opponent has been running for office on and off since the 1980s and has lost every single time. In such a tough district, it would be foolish to nominate a Democrat with a history of losing every race they’ve run.

Josh has a proven record of winning elections by building coalitions and bringing people together from both parties. In Congress, Josh will be a dynamic and high-energy member of the Problem Solvers Caucus.

And with the rise of ever-more-extreme, far-right candidates, we can’t afford to lose any seats in the House and risk electing candidates with divisive partisan agendas. Chip in now and stand with Josh right now! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jg-lafazan-split-2208?amount=10]

Recently, we’ve seen the dangers of radical positions on reproductive rights and on gun safety. If we want to move our country forward, we can’t let the loudest and most extreme voices dominate our politics.

That’s why I’ve joined the movement to elect a leader in NY-03 who will focus on common-sense policy, open-minded conversation, and who is determined to solve problems.

That’s why I know that — with your generous support right now — Josh Lafazan will win in New York, and we’re going to successfully defend our majority in Congress. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jg-lafazan-split-2208?amount=10]

President Biden has replaced Postmaster General Louis DeJoy’s last allies on the USPS Board leaving him virtually powerless | | |
---
| | Earlier this month, the USPS Board of Governors met and discussed the future of the USPS. And good news: **President Biden has now appointed a MAJORITY of the Board, ripping power away from Trump’s handpicked Postmaster General Louis DeJoy!** DeJoy’s key allies have been replaced with labor leaders, experienced public servants, and other experts – a move that will make it easier to defend voting by mail, and make the USPS work for the American people. And with this change, DeJoy no longer has unchecked power to uphold the unprecedented voter suppression tactics we witnessed last cycle – like slowing down the mail service, interfering with voting by mail in the middle of a pandemic, and so much more. [We’re thrilled President Biden has taken this step to protect the USPS after years of Republican efforts to destroy it. clean_body: President Biden has replaced Postmaster General Louis DeJoy’s last allies on the USPS Board leaving him virtually powerless | | | | | Earlier this month, the USPS Board of Governors met and discussed the future of the USPS. And good news: President Biden has now appointed a MAJORITY of the Board, ripping power away from Trump’s handpicked Postmaster General Louis DeJoy! DeJoy’s key allies have been replaced with labor leaders, experienced public servants, and other experts – a move that will make it easier to defend voting by mail, and make the USPS work for the American people. I remember my first memory of voting like it was yesterday.
Fair Fight |
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49598870/362765322/1793776944?refcode=em_20220822_e_c_stories_v1s3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYThlMTZlYi02ODIyLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=riOjItKoBHxdwELuELLWcaa65FfCMLsTwclA-2QZrYI=&emci=298e16eb-6822-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=2a8e16eb-6822-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=1037277)

| | I remember my first memory of voting like it was yesterday. For as long as I can remember, I went to vote with my mom. I would pull the levers and open the curtain to cast our ballot. And, I recall being in elementary school and my 5th grade teacher emphasizing how she would always vote because it had been so hard for Black people to vote in America. From those women and others in my life, the value of civic participation was instilled in me at an early age. But, that didn’t mean that voting was always easy. I distinctly recall standing in a long line during one election after my mom got off work and being told her name wasn’t on the list of registered voters at that precinct. The only way to ensure she could vote that day was to race across town to the Board of Elections office before it closed. Unfortunately, my mom’s story of long lines, inaccurate voting lists, and doing more than should be necessary to cast her ballot is the norm for so many voters in America. And every time I think about this memory, it reminds me that many Americans have this kind of experience at the polls. And that reminds me why the work we do at Fair Fight Action to protect the freedom to vote is so important. **Because our democracy is fragile, we must work at it every day by protecting our most fundamental rights, including the freedom to vote. And we can do this by ensuring every eligible voter has access to the polls safely and freely.** [_**The team at Fair Fight Action would love to hear about your first memory of voting. Let’s celebrate what we’re fighting for: the right to make our voices heard in our democracy. clean_body: I remember my first memory of voting like it was yesterday. Fair Fight | | | I remember my first memory of voting like it was yesterday. For as long as I can remember, I went to vote with my mom. I would pull the levers and open the curtain to cast our ballot. And, I recall being in elementary school and my 5th grade teacher emphasizing how she would always vote because it had been so hard for Black people to vote in America. From those women and others in my life, the value of civic participation was instilled in me at an early age. But, that didn’t mean that voting was always easy. I distinctly recall standing in a long line during one election after my mom got off work and being told her name wasn’t on the list of registered voters at that precinct. The only way to ensure she could vote that day was to race across town to the Board of Elections office before it closed. Unfortunately, my mom’s story of long lines, inaccurate voting lists, and doing more than should be necessary to cast her ballot is the norm for so many voters in America. And every time I think about this memory, it reminds me that many Americans have this kind of experience at the polls. And that reminds me why the work we do at Fair Fight Action to protect the freedom to vote is so important. Because our democracy is fragile, we must work at it every day by protecting our most fundamental rights, including the freedom to vote. And we can do this by ensuring every eligible voter has access to the polls safely and freely. | Thanks so much for sharing, Cianti Stewart-Reid Executive Director, Fair Fight Action = | 1270 Caroline Street Suite D120-430 Atlanta, GA 30307 ©2022 Fair Fight Action - All rights reserved. MAGA Republicans, the folks waiting in the wings with Trump, they all know this. That’s why the attack ads are already underway. So today, I’m hoping for as many small-dollar donations as possible — split between the four of us — to fight back. That’s why I’m asking: Can you split a contribution between Catherine Cortez Masto, Maggie Hassan, Reverend Raphael Warnock, and me—plus our friend Kirsten Gillibrand? Our campaigns are already facing some of the most relentless attack ads this cycle, so your donation could not come at a more important time: When the four of us win this November, know the donation you split today contributed to that victory. - Mark

name: Marco
subject: I'm sorry
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate
body:
I just want to start off by saying - I'm so sorry.
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| |
---
| | | Fellow Conservative,

I just want to start off by saying - I'm so sorry.

I hate that I have to drop into your inbox like this, but I'm humbly asking you to read this all the way through. If you get to the end and still think your $13 doesn't matter, then you may end up paying more at the pump, in the grocery store checkout, and on Tax Day.

Earlier this week, I fell $3,246 short of my Mid-Month goal. This is a disaster since a poll on Tuesday showed me LOSING to a former Trump Impeachment Manager. I can't stress this enough, but my race WILL decide whether or not Republicans take back control of our country. That means we have two options:
1. Let a Pelosi-Endorsed candidate continue to outraise us and outspend us on TV until she wins Florida and the Senate.
2. **We can start working like a team to stop the Democrats from running our country into the ground.**

I know you get a lot of these messages, but these are REAL goals and REAL deadlines we need to meet. _**[I'm humbly asking you to chip in $13 to meet this critical extended deadline and join the team that gets America back on track.](http://trk.readactnews. "I'm humbly asking you to chip in $13 to meet this critical extended deadline and join the team that gets America back on track.")**_
---
| | | [STAND WITH MARCO](http://trk.readactnews. "STAND WITH MARCO")
---
Do I need to remind you that just last week it was reported that my opponent raised more in one month than I was able to raise all of last quarter? **My opponent is gaining momentum and I desperately need your support.**
---
| | | [RESTORE THE AMERICAN DREAM >>](http://trk.readactnews. "RESTORE THE AMERICAN DREAM >>")
---
Please, Fellow Conservative, I’m begging. **Don't look back and wish you did more.**

– Marco Rubio

I’m not going to lie, this scares me. We are less than 100 days until the election and my far-Left opponent is raising millions of dollars and gaining ground in the polls.

Peter, I can’t quite believe how close we are.

In less than 24 hours, polls will open, and the final voters will make their choice.

I am deeply honored that my name is on the ballot to represent this district, my home. I’m incredibly grateful to those of you who have shown your support.

Thank you.

We’ll be working hard all day tomorrow to reach the last few voters who have yet to cast a ballot. Before then, I have to take one final opportunity to ask you to contribute to make this campaign a success.

It has been 102 years since the 19th Amendment granted women the right to vote, but we are still fighting for equality.
Sign our petition to urge the Senate to pass federal protections for voting rights immediately! [https://secure.ngpvan.com/Bt1BBy8ctkWDSz8GmC0LzQ2]
Sign now [https://secure.ngpvan.com/Bt1BBy8ctkWDSz8GmC0LzQ2]
Peter,
In a few days, we will celebrate an important anniversary for our country and our democracy. On August 26th, 1920, the 19th Amendment was formally adopted into the US Constitution, ensuring women the right to vote. In 2022, more than 100 years after the 19th Amendment, American women are still fighting for our fundamental freedoms. From equal pay to abortion access, the future of women’s rights is on the line.
In order to elect leaders who represent the best interests of women, we must ensure that every eligible voter has equal access to the polls. When everyday people have access to voting, they are able to vote for people who will best represent their communities.
That is why I am asking you to sign on to my petition asking the Senate to pass comprehensive voting rights legislation immediately! [https://secure.ngpvan.com/Bt1BBy8ctkWDSz8GmC0LzQ2]
Sign now [https://secure.ngpvan.com/Bt1BBy8ctkWDSz8GmC0LzQ2]Without access to the ballot box, the fight for gender equality, reproductive justice, and paid family leave will be much more difficult. Everything depends on our ability to be heard at the ballot box.
Sign now [https://secure.ngpvan.com/Bt1BBy8ctkWDSz8GmC0LzQ2]Thanks for signing on.
Jena Griswold
My name is Jena Griswold. In 2018, I was elected as the first democratic Secretary of State in Colorado since 1958, the first democratic woman Secretary of State in Colorado’s history, and only the 10th woman in Colorado’s history to hold the statewide constitutional office of governor, attorney general, secretary of state, or treasurer!

Friend, I'm reaching out today to talk about what makes Florida so different. It comes down to one word: decency.
Like you, I've been shocked and dismayed by how vulgar and mean-spirited our politics have become. I was devastated to learn of the Supreme Court's decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade_.
Leaders should work to unite us around policies that will help everyone, not divide and distract us. And I know from experience that it starts at the top.
Every day, I strive to live according to The Golden Rule: "_Do unto others as you would have them do unto you._ "
Our current Governor doesn’t seem to share those same values.

* We support common-sense gun reform to put an end to terrible mass shootings.
* We support women's autonomy over their own bodies.
* And we overwhelmingly support following the science to guide us out of the COVID-19 pandemic instead of spreading anti-vaccine conspiracy theories.

Unfortunately, Governor DeSantis doesn't agree with the vast majority of Floridians on these issues. His radical agenda is extreme and out of line with Florida values.
We can stop his dangerous agenda — but only if we’re willing to stand up and do our part.
DeSantis may not care about decency, but I believe Floridians still do. If you agree, I hope you’ll take a stand for what you believe in. We all have to do our part to ensure that decency will trump divisiveness.

As a result of the tough fundraising environment Republicans are seeing across the nation, we're not raising enough money to run the campaign that we need to be running. That means we've had to make some hard decisions. We made the toughest call we've had to make since last August. We don't have enough money in the bank to keep our TV ads on air. As of last week, our ads are no longer running across Georgia. Meanwhile, our opponent Raphael Warnock has more cash than he knows what to do with. He has more than $22 million in the bank and is raising MILLIONS MORE each WEEK. While our campaign doesn't have the money to keep our ads running, Raphael Warnock could run ads for the next 11 weeks without raising another dollar. I need your help. | **Inflation Reduction Act**
---
|
---
| Three things everyone should know about the Inflation Reduction Act: This week President Biden signed the Inflation Reduction Act – with this law, the American people won and special interests lost. Here are the three things everyone should know: 1. Democrats are lowering health care, prescription drug, and utility costs for working families. 2. Democrats sided with the American people and Republicans sided with special interests. Every single Republican opposed requiring big corporations to pay their fair share, and lowering costs for families. 3. President Biden and Democrats demonstrated that the government can work for working families. [Read President Biden’s full op-ed here.](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=f6db1160c6&e=d6c5c7d7ec) Supporting Rural Communities:
* Because seniors disproportionately choose to live in rural America, rural Americans stand to disproportionately benefit from the Inflation Reduction Act as it lowers prescription drug costs for seniors on Medicare. Thanks to the American Rescue Plan, 65 percent (1.3 million) of the 1.9 million rural uninsured Americans in states using the HealthCare.gov had access to a $0-premium health insurance plan for 2021. The Inflation Reduction Act will help keep free or low-cost health insurance available to rural Americans, with average savings of about $800 per person per year.

Supporting Latino Communities:
* High prices contribute to racial and ethnic health inequities. Among adults 65 and older, Latino Medicare beneficiaries were roughly [1.5 times](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=7a4b3fa088&e=d6c5c7d7ec) as likely as White beneficiaries to have trouble affording medications, and about [2 times](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=270f7f65d9&e=d6c5c7d7ec) as likely to not fill needed prescriptions due to cost. For example, a recent study of shingles vaccination rates among older Americans showed non-Latino White Americans were over [2 times](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=d8531295f7&e=d6c5c7d7ec) as likely to have received the shingles vaccine than Latinos, due in part to difficulty affording the shingles vaccine. The Inflation Reduction Act will help close the gap in access to medication by improving prescription drug coverage and lowering drug prices in Medicare.

Supporting Black Communities:
* Almost [3.9 million Black people](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=42a9f2c412&e=d6c5c7d7ec) were uninsured in 2019 before President Biden took office and over [570,000 Black people](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=e3fccdad87&e=d6c5c7d7ec) fell into the Medicaid “coverage gap” and were locked out of coverage because their state refused to expand Medicaid. Since President Biden took office, the uninsured rate has reached a new historic law: 8% and 5.2 million of Americans have gained health insurance coverage. The Inflation Reduction Act continues the American Rescue Plan’s more generous Affordable Care Act premium tax credits.

Supporting Tribal Communities:
* The Inflation Reduction Act includes investments for a Tribal Electrification Program for Tribes and Tribal organizations to provide electricity to unelectrified Tribal homes through zero-emission energy systems, and to transition electrified homes to zero-emission energy systems. The Inflation Reduction Act also provides additional investments for the Tribal Energy Loan Guarantee Program, and increases loan guarantees for Tribal energy development from $2 billion to $20 billion.

Supporting AANHPI Communities:
* According to the Small Business Administration, 2 million Asian American, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific Islander-owned small businesses in the U.S. generate more than $700 billion in revenues and create 3.6 million jobs. The Inflation Reduction Act includes a number of provisions that will save small business owners money.

Supporting Young Americans:
* This law represents the single most aggressive action the U.S. is taking to tackle the climate crisis and create clean energy solutions in American history. The law will bring down energy costs for families and create thousands of good jobs, all while reducing climate pollution and ensuring that we have a clean, secure future energy supply. The law would reduce about a gigaton (a billion metric tons) of greenhouse gas emissions in 2030 and position America to meet President Biden’s climate goals of cutting climate pollution in half by 2030 and reaching net-zero emissions by no later than 2050.

President Biden and Democrats rack up win after win: President Biden and congressional Democrats have beat special interests to deliver game-changing wins for American families including:
* Inflation Reduction Act to lower prescription drug, health insurance, and energy costs, and fight inflation – all while reducing the federal deficit and finally making big corporations and billionaire tax cheats pay their fair share.
* CHIPS and Science Act to lower costs, create American jobs, and increase competitiveness with China.
* PACT Act to ensure veterans get the health care benefits they’ve earned.
* Gun reform for the first time in 30 years.
* Bipartisan Infrastructure Law to fix our roads and bridges.
* American Rescue Plan to get us out of the pandemic by creating millions of jobs, funding our vaccination campaign, and reopening our schools.
* Gas prices are below $4 a gallon on average, and we have one of the best jobs markets in history as unemployment is matching a 50-year low.

Join us and hear directly from Democratic leadership and special guests, and learn more about how you can do your part in electing Democrats in November. | "RSVP Here" | | Inflation Reduction Act | | Three things everyone should know about the Inflation Reduction Act: This week President Biden signed the Inflation Reduction Act – with this law, the American people won and special interests lost. Here are the three things everyone should know: 1. Democrats are lowering health care, prescription drug, and utility costs for working families. 2. Democrats sided with the American people and Republicans sided with special interests. Every single Republican opposed requiring big corporations to pay their fair share, and lowering costs for families. 3. President Biden and Democrats demonstrated that the government can work for working families. Supporting Rural Communities: Because seniors disproportionately choose to live in rural America, rural Americans stand to disproportionately benefit from the Inflation Reduction Act as it lowers prescription drug costs for seniors on Medicare. Thanks to the American Rescue Plan, 65 percent (1.3 million) of the 1.9 million rural uninsured Americans in states using the HealthCare.gov had access to a $0-premium health insurance plan for 2021. The Inflation Reduction Act will help keep free or low-cost health insurance available to rural Americans, with average savings of about $800 per person per year. Supporting Latino Communities: High prices contribute to racial and ethnic health inequities. Among adults 65 and older, Latino Medicare beneficiaries were roughly as likely as White beneficiaries to have trouble affording medications, and about as likely to not fill needed prescriptions due to cost. For example, a recent study of shingles vaccination rates among older Americans showed non-Latino White Americans were over as likely to have received the shingles vaccine than Latinos, due in part to difficulty affording the shingles vaccine. The Inflation Reduction Act will help close the gap in access to medication by improving prescription drug coverage and lowering drug prices in Medicare. Supporting Black Communities: Almost were uninsured in 2019 before President Biden took office and over fell into the Medicaid “coverage gap” and were locked out of coverage because their state refused to expand Medicaid. Since President Biden took office, the uninsured rate has reached a new historic law: 8% and 5.2 million of Americans have gained health insurance coverage. The Inflation Reduction Act continues the American Rescue Plan’s more generous Affordable Care Act premium tax credits. Supporting Tribal Communities: The Inflation Reduction Act includes investments for a Tribal Electrification Program for Tribes and Tribal organizations to provide electricity to unelectrified Tribal homes through zero-emission energy systems, and to transition electrified homes to zero-emission energy systems. The Inflation Reduction Act also provides additional investments for the Tribal Energy Loan Guarantee Program, and increases loan guarantees for Tribal energy development from $2 billion to $20 billion. Supporting AANHPI Communities: According to the Small Business Administration, 2 million Asian American, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific Islander-owned small businesses in the U.S. generate more than $700 billion in revenues and create 3.6 million jobs. The Inflation Reduction Act includes a number of provisions that will save small business owners money. Supporting Young Americans: This law represents the single most aggressive action the U.S. is taking to tackle the climate crisis and create clean energy solutions in American history. The law will bring down energy costs for families and create thousands of good jobs, all while reducing climate pollution and ensuring that we have a clean, secure future energy supply. The law would reduce about a gigaton (a billion metric tons) of greenhouse gas emissions in 2030 and position America to meet President Biden’s climate goals of cutting climate pollution in half by 2030 and reaching net-zero emissions by no later than 2050. President Biden and Democrats rack up win after win: President Biden and congressional Democrats have beat special interests to deliver game-changing wins for American families including: Inflation Reduction Act to lower prescription drug, health insurance, and energy costs, and fight inflation – all while reducing the federal deficit and finally making big corporations and billionaire tax cheats pay their fair share. CHIPS and Science Act to lower costs, create American jobs, and increase competitiveness with China. PACT Act to ensure veterans get the health care benefits they’ve earned. | Peter,

It’s Josh. 286 days ago — and to be honest, it sometimes feels like a lot longer — I launched this campaign for Congress.

**If I haven’t said it enough, let me say it again: Thank you!**

From the day my family and I started this campaign, we’ve never felt like we’ve been on our own, and that’s because of the truly humbling amount of support we’ve received from all of you.

Tomorrow is our primary election, and I’ve been so grateful for all of the calls, texts, and emails from supporters letting me know that they cast a vote for our campaign by absentee ballot or through early voting. It’s amazing.

Peter, engaging with committed supporters like you has always been the best part of this campaign. _Fundraising has always been the worst._

So I’m relieved to say this is the final time I’ll email you asking for contributions before the primary election. If it’s within your capacity, we could really use one last push to reach tonight’s Election Day Countdown Fund goal — my finance team says we’re just $3,657 away.

clean_body: Judge Reinhart today affirmed his decision to deny the Biden administration’s attempt to keep the affidavit completely sealed. | | | | | | Because no one is above the law! | Aug 22, 2022 ---|---|--- Today's Top Stories | | | | == | == Judicial Watch President Tom Fitton made the following statement regarding Magistrate Judge Bruce Reinhart’s latest decision partially granting Judicial Watch’s request to unseal the affidavit and other materials used to justify the unprecedented raid on former President Trump’s home: Judge Reinhart today affirmed his decision to deny the Biden administration’s attempt to keep the affidavit completely sealed. He states in today’s ruling that “given the intense public and historical interest in an unprecedented search of a former President’s residence, the Government has not yet shown that these administrative concerns are sufficient to justify sealing.” == ---|--- | | | | | Judicial Watch announced today that it is providing legal representation to Megan Brock, a parent who is being sued by Bucks County, PA, to prevent the release of documents she requested under the commonwealth’s Right-to-Know Law that are related to COVID restrictions and the re-opening of the county’s schools. ---|--- | | | | = | = Judicial Watch achieved a key court victory today over the Biden Justice Department’s desperate move to keep the Trump warrant affidavit completely sealed. The court outright rejected the Justice Department’s brazen play to keep the whole document secret. The Biden administration’s unprecedented and abusive raid on Trump’s home has created a rule of law crisis that can only be alleviated with transparency and accountability. And, we’re thrilled that Americans will get more of both with today’s court decision, finding that at least some more information about this terrible raid should be released. = ---|--- | | | | == | == The Justice Department was ordered by Magistrate Judge Bruce Reinhart to respond last week to Judicial Watch’s Motion to Unseal the warrant and supporting materials behind the FBI raid of President Donald Trump’s home in Mar-a-Lago. In its filing, the Justice Department alleged that releasing the affidavit would “cause significant and irreparable damage” to its ongoing criminal investigation. == ---|--- | | | = Fox News The Albany Times Union newspaper and Judicial Watch have separately asked the federal magistrate to publicly release the search warrant tied to the FBI raid on former President Trump’s Mar-a-Lago residence. The FBI executed the search warrant of Trump’s Palm Beach property on Monday in what the former president characterized as an “unannounced raid” on his home. = Newsmax Tom Fitton, the president of Judicial Watch, a think tank that investigates government corruption, doesn’t believe the Department of Justice’s reported claims of former President Donald Trump potentially violating the “Espionage Act of 1917” will have much staying power, from a criminality perspective. = Judicial Watch Hundreds of unvetted Afghan refugees released in the United States by the Biden administration are on a Department of Defense (DOD) watchlist of suspected and known terrorists, according to a Pentagon whistleblower. | | **Primary Day is tomorrow, Tuesday, August 23rd! **

I want to take a moment to express how thankful I am for the outpouring of support my campaign has received from grassroots patriots throughout Western New York and the Southern Tier. If elected, I promise to fight the DC swamp that only wants to keep you silent and forgotten, but I need your vote!
Election day voting locations can be found here! [**https://voterlookup.elections.ny.gov**](https://CarlPaladino.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3bf22d0f57d54fb47b0038eb8&id=ecb31153ae&e=7e49f828ab)

I was born and raised in Western New York. After receiving my Juris Doctor degree in 1971, and then serving in the US Army, I started one of the most successful companies in our area, creating thousands of jobs.

You know my story and proven conservative record. For years I have been outspoken against the political establishment. In 2006, I fought and won to get the tolls removed from the I-190 and now I am suing our radical Governor, Kathy Hochul for her unconstitutional attack on your second amendment rights, and like back in 2006, I will win this fight. We can and will stand up to the politicians and have an impact!

I am proud to say I supported President Trump from day one! I served as his New York State chair for his 2016 campaign and will continue to support him in the best interest of the residents of the 23rd district.

**YOU can help! Please call ten of your friends and family and make sure they get out and vote and have them call 10 of their friends and family to do the same! I am counting on all of you to show up BIG tomorrow.**

The Washington establishment does not want me to win because they know I cannot be bought. My only interest is serving the great people of this district and being your voice in Congress. The liberal media has attempted to smear me but voters are smart enough not to believe their lies. Let’s send a message to DC that Western New York and the Southern Tier want a seat at the table; no more corrupt career politicians. My promise to you is that I will fight for you and deliver results for our community.

Vote Tuesday, August 23rd!

Sincerely,
Carl Paladino

clean_body: | | | | | Hello Waltz Warriors! We hope this email finds you and your families healthy and safe! Focusing on discussing the one year anniversary of Biden's botched Afghanistan withdrawal, here’s some of what Mike has been up to the last week. | In the NewsWALTZ ON ONE YEAR SINCE THE AFGHANISTAN WITHDRAWL Last Monday morning, Mike Waltz kicked off the day by joining The National Desk, saying: "Americans are still left behind. They're still there. Many of them can't leave because they can't get their family members out. Our allies, by the tens of thousands that we left behind, are being hunted down by the Taliban as we speak. Girls can't go to school, women can't leave their home much less have a job," said congressman and former U.S. Army Green Beret Rep. Michael Waltz, R -Fla. "Al-Qaeda is back just like it was pre-2001, and then add on top of that the absolute devastation to American credibility around the world." Watch the interview . WALTZ ON MAR-A-LAGO Mike joined to discuss his thoughts on the FBI raid of Mar-a-Lago, saying: "As Americans, there’s nothing we hate more than unequal treatment under the law. I’ve served all over the world in places where regimes put their political opponents in prison, and the result is almost always tyranny and bloodshed. Where that is actually exactly what people expect. I’m hearing from people across the spectrum, even from people who don’t like President Trump, who know at their core that this is wrong.House GOP Leader Kevin McCarthy has told Merrick Garland to clear his schedule and preserve all documents. And you can bet we are going to get to the bottom of this - but we have to take back Congress FIRST." Watch the entire interview for yourself Then last Tuesday, Mike Waltz joined the to further discuss the Afghanistan withdrawal: "You see it in how [the Biden admin] is dealing with Taiwan. If we just concede enough, if we just give enough, if we just sit at the table with a lot of goodies, then our adversaries will play nice too. And they just smell a weakness all over this White House." Listen to the podcast To finish off the day, Mike was on to talk about his two new ads he released this week highlighting the anniversary of the fall of Afghanistan. "It’s been a year since the Biden Administration‘s disastrous withdrawal from Afghanistan and not one senior administration official has resigned or been fired. It’s imperative we get accountability for the 13 Gold Star families and the Americans and allies we left behind terrorist lines. I hope these ads will serve as a reminder that we need to get to the bottom of this debacle" Watch the entire segment | In the District Last week, Mike was back in the district where he joined B Braun CEO Jean-Claude Dubacher for the grand opening of the new CEO facility in Daytona Beach. They’re investing $300 million to manufacture IV solution in Florida. Bringing our supply chains back home! Check out what Mike had to say about the opening in the below: Mike rounded out the week by attending the Flagler County Lincoln Day Dinner where Senator Rick Scott was the keynote speaker. subject: What I’m helping families with

body:
Can you help me keep working for IL-13’s families?
#
Peter,
Growing up, I learned about community and service from my family. They inspired me to get involved in public service, and I’ve spent my career fighting for working families since.

name: Peter Welch
subject: A community I call home
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
As I reflect on my journey in Vermont, I’m reminded of how high the stakes are, and why we cannot take anything for granted

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=823%2E61531%2EeF1yk2)
Hello,
Now that I'm your Democratic nominee for Senate in Vermont, I want you to know a bit more about me and why I'm in this race.
I’ve spent much of my life fighting for working families, and that’s a big part of why I got involved in politics—to help level the playing field.
My first real opportunity came right after I graduated law school: I had to make the decision between taking the kind of corporate or lobbying jobs my classmates were taking—or something else. I came to White River instead, because **I felt a tremendous responsibility to go where I was needed the most—right here in Vermont.** For me, it was easy to choose Bridge Street over Wall Street or K Street. It’s where I became a public defender and witnessed firsthand some of the toughest systemic barriers people faced—at no fault of their own.
And guess what? I also ended up finding a community I could call home, and I’ve been in Vermont ever since.
[](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3860?t=24&akid=823%2E61531%2EeF1yk2)
Here in Vermont, I found a community full of neighbors that reminded me of my father and the values I was raised with. As a small-town dentist, my father would throw bills in the trash meant for folks he knew were struggling. Here in Vermont, I found a community of people with those deeply rooted values—like self-reliance, mutual support, and cooperation built on trust.
Those are the values we need in Washington, and that’s why this race is so important to me—because I’ve met some of the most incredible people in Vermont, and they deserve lawmakers who will make decisions with their best interests in mind.
We deserve lawmakers who will listen more than they talk, and who focus on finding solutions more than getting credit. It’s how I’ve led as Vermont’s Congressman, and I would continue leading this way if Vermonters elect me as their next senator.
As I reflect on my journey in Vermont politics, I’m reminded of how high the stakes are. In fact, they’re higher right now than they’ve ever been because of the unprecedented threat to our democracy, our climate, and our most fundamental rights. We can’t take anything for granted.
[**You’ve been with me this far, and I’m counting on you again. Because with your support, we will continue growing this grassroots campaign and keep the Senate out of Mitch McConnell’s hands. Will you help take this grassroots movement all the way by chipping in whatever you can?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3860?t=25&akid=823%2E61531%2EeF1yk2)

**CORRUPT COURT SYSTEM PROHIBITS TINA PETERS FROM LEAVING COLORADO TO SPEAK AT ELECTION INTEGRITY EVENT OR SEE FAMILY ** **GRAND JUNCTION, CO** \-- Per the request of the Mesa County District Attorney, Clerk Tina Peters has been prohibited from leaving the state of Colorado to speak at election integrity events. This past weekend the “Moment of Truth Summit” was held in Springfield, MO in which Clerk Peters was not only supposed to be a key speaker – but also a movie, Clerk Peters had a key role in was being premiered. The movie, “Selection Code” is about potential voter fraud in past elections. In a sincere effort to respect the Colorado Court system, and demonstrate to her supporters, her respect for the law even when it is unfairly applied – Clerk Peters submitted all necessary documentation and details to leave the state of Colorado to attend this pivotal event. In his opposition to Clerk Peters’s travel the District Attorney did not say he believed Clerk Peters would be a flight risk, he did not say he believed it would place on going legal proceedings in jeopardy, he did not say that he believed Clerk Peters would be a risk to anyone if she traveled. The District Attorney said plainly he opposed her travel to speak at the event because he found the content of the event to be “ _**offensive.**_ ” Let us be clear – the District Attorney offered no legal reasoning as to why Clerk Peters should be barred from attending and speaking at this event. **Clerk Peters was barred from attending and speaking at the event because the District Attorney found the content offensive. ** **Clerk Peters requests to visit her 93 year old mother, her daughter and granddaughter have also been denied.**

subject: Answering a few frequently asked questions
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Beto for Texas
body:
[1]Beto O'Rourke

Last week, we announced our first TV ad buy with reservations in major
markets across Texas.

In a moment, [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220822-2.cFTx-j&refcode=ema20220822-204323&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=204323%2E444211%2EQRhlWm ]we are going to ask you to pitch in a donation to help us
get these ads in front of millions of voters across Texas. But first, we
wanted to take a moment to explain why this is such a big deal and answer
some FAQs.

Why are we launching this ad now?

Greg Abbott’s support has plummeted as Beto has cut the gap in this race
by 10 points, but millions of Texans still need to hear about the full
extent of Abbott’s extreme agenda. Our new ads will tell the truth about
his actions and hold him accountable for his failures.

What are the most important things Texans need to know about Abbott?

Greg Abbott signed the nation’s most extreme abortion bill into law with
no exception for rape or incest, even though 82% of Texans reject his
radical ban. Greg Abbott has also done absolutely nothing to stop the next
school shooting after six major mass shootings on his watch, even though a
majority of Texans think he should call a Special Session and take action.

What do you think the ad will accomplish?

At every town hall we’re hosting in communities across Texas during our
49-day Drive for Texas, we’re seeing voters of every background
— including many Republicans and Independents — choose Beto’s positive,
unifying vision once they see it compared to Abbott’s extremism.

Our new TV ads will make the choice in this race clear to millions of
additional Texans. If we can air ads across Texas in the weeks to come, we
will grow the broad coalition of voters we need to win.

How can I help?

Our initial ad buy was made possible by grassroots donors, and we couldn’t
be more grateful. But keeping these ads in front of voters is expensive —
especially in a state as big as Texas. It costs roughly $1,485,000 to go
live in the top four major TV markets just for a week.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220822-2.cFTx-j&refcode=ema20220822-204323&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=204323%2E444211%2EQRhlWm ]Now that you’ve learned more about why this ad is critical to winning,
will you consider pitching in any amount to help us reach our ambitious
goal of funding our $1,485,000 TV ad budget?

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220822-2.cFTx-j&refcode=ema20220822-204323&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=204323%2E444211%2EQRhlWm ]Contribute $3

Together, we will ensure every Texan knows about Abbott’s dangerous
extremism, deadly incompetence, and nonstop failures that continue to hold
this state back. Texas deserves better.

Thanks for your help,

Team Beto

If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://act.betoorourke.com/unsubscribe/bft-unsubscribe/?t=1022&akid=204323%2E444211%2EQRhlWm

The Texas Tribune:
“New Texas law increasing penalties for abortion providers goes into effect August 25”
July 26, 2022

Texas’ trigger law goes into effect this Thursday.
It’s called a trigger law because it’s “triggered” into effect by the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade . The law targets health care workers who provide abortion care and bans nearly all abortions with few exceptions. The provisions are extreme: Health care providers found to have violated the law could lose their medical license, be sentenced from five years to life in prison, and fined up to $10,000.
Extreme lawmakers in Texas (and across the country) have made it clear they won’t let up their efforts to take away our rights to make our own decisions about our bodies, our families, and our futures. Texas’ attorney general already sued the Biden Administration for its executive order protecting doctors providing abortions in emergencies.
Texas is ground zero for these attacks. That’s why I’m not giving up — frankly, it’s just not an option. In Congress, I’m working to protect our right to reproductive care and our ability to access it:

**Unity Tour in Green County
** The Republican Party of Green County was honored to host a segment of Tim Michel’s Unity Tour! Tim Michels and his family, Roger Roth, John Leiber, and many grassroots activists were in attendance!
**Clark County Fair
** The Clark County Republicans had a great time talking with voters and recruiting volunteers at the Clark County Fair!
**Polk County Annual Picnic
** The Republican Party of Polk County had their annual picnic in Osceola with over 100 attendees! The event featured multiple speakers, including State Rep. Gae Magnafici!
**Kenosha County Reagan Day Picnic
** Kenosha County Republicans hosted their Reagan Day Picnic and featured Rep. Bryan Steil, State Treasurer Nominee John Leiber, and Attorney General Nominee Eric Toney! \
**Kenosha County Fair
** Patriots in Kenosha County were greeted by the Kenosha County GOP booth, which was decked out with hats, yard signs, and more!
**Pierce County Fair
** The Pierce County Republicans had a great time hosting their booth at the Pierce County Fair!
**River Falls Office Opening
** Freedom Fighters in Pierce County celebrated the opening of their Ron Johnson Field Office! They were joined by Derrick Van Orden, Dave Estenson, and Shannon Zimmerman!
**Onalaska Meet and Greet
** Monroe County Republicans traveled to Onalaska to meet Tim Michels and Roger Roth to discuss their plans to move Wisconsin forward!
**Norwalk Parade
** Monroe County Republicans walked through the Norwalk County Parade with State Rep. Nancy VanderMeer, State Rep. Loren Oldenburg, and Monroe County Sheriff Wes Revels.
**Monroe County Movie Showing
** The Republican Party of Monroe County hosted another successful movie night with countless attendees!
**Brown County Fair
** The Republican Party of Brown County was well-represented at the Brown County Fair, with lots of literature and information on our conservative candidates!
**Green Bay Unity Tour
** Patriots in Green Bay were greeted by Tim Michels and Roger Roth in a packed house of 8th Congressional District Leadership and enthusiastic supporters!
**Oconto County Fair
** The Republican Party of Oconto County had a fantastic booth at their County Fair!
**Outagamie County Meeting
** The Outagamie County Republicans had their first membership meeting with speakers from Pro-Life Wisconsin and Vida Health!
**Germantown Office Opening
** Republicans in Washington County had a great time at their office's grand opening with Senator Ron Johnson and an overflow crowd!
**Germantown Unity Tour
** Conservatives in Germantown got to hear from Tim Michels and Ron Johnson at their stop on the Unity Tour!
**Winnebago County Fair
** The Winnebago County Republicans tabled at their County Fair in support of our conservative candidates!

Friend, I wanted to take a moment to talk to you about tomorrow's primary election in Florida.
In less than 24 hours, Val Demings will become the official Democratic nominee in Florida's Senate race – and her nomination could not come at a more critical moment.
**For over a decade now, Val Demings' opponent, Marco Rubio, has _proudly_ been a part of the GOP's assault on reproductive rights.** He has gone to dangerous lengths to maintain government control over women's bodies, including: supporting the Supreme Court's decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ and writing a bill to limit women's access to birth control.

clean_body: | | | Dear friend, I’m sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but we have to face the facts. Democrat Senator Raphael Warnock is raising money hand over fist for his Senate race in Georgia. Meanwhile, even though super star Herschel Walker is one of the top Republican fundraisers in the country, he had to pull down his TV ads to save money for the final stretch. That means Georgia voters are not hearing his side of the story right now. And we need to fix that right away. You see, Georgia is an expensive state for running television ads. It costs Herschel’s campaign $2 MILLION A WEEK just to get his message out statewide. Raphael Warnock has enough money in his campaign war chest to bombard the Georgia airwaves without raising another penny! WE CAN DO THIS — but only if everyone does their part. So whether you can give $5 or $500, please read Herschel’s email and donate right away so we can flip this seat from BLUE to RED and take back control of the U.S. Senate! My very best, Nikki \--------- Forwarded Message ---------From: Herschel Walker Subject: Herschel Walker's TV ads just went dark...To: | | Friend, I had hoped it wouldn't come to this, but I'd prefer to be the one to tell you rather than let the Democrats leak the news to the mainstream media. As a result of the tough fundraising environment Republicans are seeing across the nation, we're not raising enough money to run the campaign that we need to be running. That means we've had to make some hard decisions. Today we made the toughest call we've had to make since last August. We don't have enough money in the bank to keep our TV ads on air. As of this morning, our ads are no longer running across Georgia. Meanwhile, our opponent Raphael Warnock has more cash than he knows what to do with. He has more than $22 million in the bank and is raising MILLIONS MORE each WEEK. While our campaign doesn't have the money to keep our ads running, Raphael Warnock could run ads for the next 11 weeks without raising another dollar. I need your help. The more money we raise today, the sooner we can get back on the air. It takes $2 million per week to run TV ads across Georgia. This might seem like a big number — and it is — I am counting on you. clean_body: Running for Senate required a big leap of faith -- faith in our mission and faith that enough people like you would step up to support our work. | | I’m personally reaching out because we have fewer than 100 days left until critical elections like mine in North Carolina. We need to elect more Democratic leaders this November, and grassroots donations go a long way towards the work to build a better America. Running for Senate required a big leap of faith -- faith in our mission and faith that enough people like you would step up to support our work. Winning a race as tough as mine has to be a team effort. It requires all of us to do the hard work together. Right now, we need folks like you to come through for our campaign. Our campaign noticed a bit of a slow down in fundraising, and honestly, it has our team a bit concerned. My Republican opponent has some of the biggest special interests in politics aggressively trying to buy his seat. I don’t believe this seat or our next senator’s vote should be for sale. We need a leader who will always put people first. So that’s why your support is so important. Derek, I’m coming to you directly to ask you to chip in for the first time to help close our budget gap. Whether you can pitch in $10 or any amount you can, no donation is too small. **Can you please split a $10 donation to our campaign, to flip North Carolina’s Senate seat, and the DNC, to help elect Democrats across the country? We still have a lot of ground to cover and cannot afford to fall short heading into the fall. ** People are truly the power behind this campaign. If we are going to win in November, what matters the most is that we do this together. Your support means more to me than you can ever know, so thank you from the bottom of my heart. [**To give our efforts an extra boost, we’re aiming to reach a $50,000 goal before the end of the month. We’ve made significant progress on fair maps -- but that is just one piece of the puzzle as we strive toward a stronger, resilient democracy.
We know that if we don’t have free and fair elections, we can’t fully realize the impact of those fair maps. And that’s where our multi-pronged strategy comes into play. It looks like this:
**We’re working to preserve and expand access to voting.** As state legislatures try to curtail voting rights, we’re on the ground in communities to help protect and get out the vote. And in the courts, our affiliate is involved in two critical Supreme Court cases that have the potential to protect or threaten free and fair federal elections. Democracy is literally on the docket.
**We are protecting election infrastructure.** We know that some are actively recruiting election deniers to serve as poll workers, and we need to do everything we can to defend our democracy against this effort. Poll workers must share the same mission: to conduct free and fair elections, no matter the outcome. That’s why we are partnering with Power the Polls to support nonpartisan efforts to recruit more citizens to sign up to do their civic duty and give back to their communities.
**We are going to the polls.** We’ll be encouraging our vast grassroots network to engage in the 2022 election, by organizing and supporting citizens getting to the polls. We fought for and won fair maps in many places, now it’s time to have our voices heard at the ballot box.
**In order to _protect_ democracy, we have to _do_ democracy. **
This work is vital, and it will affect not only ourselves, but also our children and our children’s children. _Democracy is fragile, and it cannot defend itself -- that’s where we need your help._

clean_body: | Friend -- As the January 6 investigations have made clear, the threat to our democracy is grave, and it will require a systemic response to fight off future attacks. That’s why I’m proud to announce that All On The Line is launching new initiatives to strengthen our democracy and safeguard our elections. = = We’ve made significant progress on fair maps -- but that is just one piece of the puzzle as we strive toward a stronger, resilient democracy. We know that if we don’t have free and fair elections, we can’t fully realize the impact of those fair maps. And that’s where our multi-pronged strategy comes into play. It looks like this: We’re working to preserve and expand access to voting. As state legislatures try to curtail voting rights, we’re on the ground in communities to help protect and get out the vote. And in the courts, our affiliate is involved in two critical Supreme Court cases that have the potential to protect or threaten free and fair federal elections. Democracy is literally on the docket. We are protecting election infrastructure. We know that some are actively recruiting election deniers to serve as poll workers, and we need to do everything we can to defend our democracy against this effort. Poll workers must share the same mission: to conduct free and fair elections, no matter the outcome. That’s why we are partnering with Power the Polls to support nonpartisan efforts to recruit more citizens to sign up to do their civic duty and give back to their communities. We are going to the polls. We’ll be encouraging our vast grassroots network to engage in the 2022 election, by organizing and supporting citizens getting to the polls. We fought for and won fair maps in many places, now it’s time to have our voices heard at the ballot box. In order to protect democracy, we have to do democracy. This work is vital, and it will affect not only ourselves, but also our children and our children’s children. Democracy is fragile, and it cannot defend itself -- that’s where we need your help. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = Thank you, Eric H.
